cards.name: Petristar
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.flavorText: It always charges ahead into enemy lines. As if it is afraid of falling behind.

cards.name: Sun Spawn
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: Even before breaking free from its shell, its fighting spirit burns fiercely. This is truly the child of the crimson sky.

cards.name: Scud Beast
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse
cards.flavorText: The moment you think you're just looking at a drifting cloud, claws and fangs suddenly shoot out of it. It's the perfect ambush.

cards.name: Kukulakatol
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target a Spirit card with [Clash] in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: That tail does not merely crush the enemy. It pierces right through the ground.

cards.name: Pergasos
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText:
I seem to recall seeing a race featuring a horse with such a mane of flame. Well, that horse didn't have wings, mind you...
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: Pawgriffo
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It charges again and again with unexpected ferocity. Perhaps it is because there is a rival right beside it.

galleryImages.caption: April-May 2026 Standard Format Shop Battle Promo/Battlers' Pack Vol.1
Promo Ver. Full Art by Shingo (https://x.com/shingo5/status/2085569799309136292?s=20)

cards.name: Glitail
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit. Destroy it.
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: He charges again and again with astonishing boldness. Perhaps it's because he got a worthy rival close to him.

cards.name: Cockadrice
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. For each Spirit with [Clash] you control, the targeting BP gets +1000.

cards.flavorText: Although it can't turn its enemies into stones with its breath, it can turn them into charcoal.

galleryImages.caption: June-July 2026 Standard Format Shop Battle Promo/Battlers' Pack Vol.2

cards.name: The RedGuide Shaniel
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
All your Spirits with [Clash] gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: It is said that there is no end to those who seek that whip, be they foe or friend.

cards.name: The FlyingDauntless Falconiforme
cards.jpName: 飛勇ファルコニフォーメ
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. If you control any exhausted "Windfang" family Spirit, change the targeting BP to 5000 or less instead.

cards.flavorText: His gaze is as sharp as the point of a spear.

cards.name: Gino-Ankh
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: Target an opposing Nexus. Destroy it

cards.flavorText: To solve this Spirit's riddle requires both considerable knowledge and nerve.

cards.name: Regulinaz
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: [LV1-2] (During Attack) Invoke Flash (Once Per Turn) Discard a "Windfang" family card from your Hand ▶ During this battle, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Distance is irrelevant when facing this Spirit. No matter how far away it is, it closes the gap in an instant.

cards.name: Thorel
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: [LV1-2] [Clash](During Attack) Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, you can target up to three of your Spirits with [Clash]. Send up to a total of three cores, besides , from your Trash to them.

cards.flavorText: "O Lord! Behold my valor!"

cards.name: The DragonSteed Rostache
cards.setName: The Genesis Pulse

effects.text: [LV1-2] (When Summoned) Target a Cost 5 or less Red Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.
Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.name: Lizardman
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't block Spirits with BP inferior to this Spirit's.

cards.flavorText: The guys in the neutral position tend to support the losing side. Those dragons who were overlooked out of mercy are so miserable.

cards.name: Jurassickle
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +4000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
I prepared for death when it flung up its scythe-looking arms. At that moment, no one could predict that it would let me live.
-from the 4th paragraph in chapter red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The BladeDragon Steelanodon
cards.jpName: 翼刃竜スティラノドン
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: He says he gets more excited if his enemy is big. He also says that the fortress is the best target to demolish. Whether its an enemy or not doesn't mean much to him.

cards.name: The FlameDragon Ma-Gwo
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: For each "Dragon" family Spirit on your Field, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The legend is coming back to life again... Once the dragon wakes up, he won't sleep until he destroys everything.

cards.name: The Sickle Fool-Joker
cards.jpName: 大鎌フール・ジョーカー
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can destroy a 3000 BP or less Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Hey, what are you staring at? I have no interest in who wins the battle. The only thing that matters to me is how long it's gonna last, OK?

cards.name: The Fire LithoGraphica Phoenixious
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Destroy every 3000 BP or less Spirit.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The fools who burned down the woods also got burned down. They are the only ones who benefited from it. Yes, they love flames.

galleryImages.caption: The Fire LithoGraphica Phoenixious — Card Art
The Fire LithoGraphica Phoenixious — Alternate Art

cards.name: The CrystalDragon Diamat
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can destroy a Spirit with [High Speed].

cards.flavorText: Do you know the word "Hybrid"? It seems like this guy was the cause of the fight. Most of the time, cases of the fight are nothing.

cards.name: The DragonicFortress Giga
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, you can send any number of cores from this Spirit to other Spirits/Nexuses you control.

cards.flavorText: Dragons have no knowledge of moderation whatsoever. What are they gonna do with this thing?

cards.name: Foger
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: Wherever the traitors hide, the shadow will track them down and terminate them.

cards.name: Will-Orb
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: If this Spirit can attack, it must attack.

cards.flavorText: Even if you see a light, don't run after it. There are some guys inside of the ruin waiting to take your life.

cards.name: Skulldevil
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: An evil aura veils the world. Even the lowest-class prison guard takes many lives. Don't look up. One glance will be enough for them to take everything from you.

cards.name: Rib-Reaper
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While there is any Red Spirit/Nexus on your Field, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: There is no peace even after death in this world. Your body is controlled and forced to labor as their soldier.

cards.name: Grip-Hands
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Those who inadvertently stepped into the king's territory were crushed in their hands.

cards.name: Death-Haides
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: The judge who punishes the traitors won't show any mercy against them. There is no word such as "innocent" in their dictionary.

galleryImages.caption: Death-Haides blocked by a Silent Wall

cards.name: Gawrm
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return this Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: It won't stop chasing you even with its head chopped off. It reincarnates over and over again.

cards.name: Disaster
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: If this Spirit can attack, it must attack.

cards.flavorText: The flame tornado generated in the prairie continuously burned down the fugitives till it burned itself out.

cards.name: Bi-Python
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It was an old snake with extensive knowledge that filled them with ideas of rebellion.

cards.name: Bone-Gladiator
cards.jpName: ボーン・グラディエイター
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't be blocked by Green Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They were the first ones who showed up there. However, they lost their green power just by standing there, and the field changed itself to the withered world.

cards.name: Sha-Zoo
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Exhaust up to two Spirits.

cards.flavorText: Its distorted death cry sullies the soul. Once you hear it, you'll faint and if it's close, it'll take your life.

cards.name: Illusiona
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can target an opposing exhausted Spirit and attack it.

cards.flavorText: Whenever someone speaks ill of the king, the prison guard always rushes to that place. There always was a small black cat near the victims.

cards.name: Skel-Viper
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Even the dark snake cannot escape from the control of the king once it dies. The body just turns into a miserable slave.

cards.name: The Mysteryman Dionaeman
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: These zombies kept digging the graves to find bodies that they need to become royal soldiers.

cards.name: Darkwitch
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Destroy an exhausted Spirit you or the opponent controls.

cards.flavorText: The high-class ones never touch you. They just pass and you're dead already.

cards.name: Cobraiga
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Leaving only one core on a Spirit, and send every other core from it to its owner's Reserve.

cards.flavorText: In the inner part of the ruins, the traitors met the dark snake that protects the wisdom.

cards.name: Mistweasel
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Draw three cards.

cards.flavorText: A small spiritual beast that battles against the envoys from the evil world. It gives a light of hope to the traitors and disappears before they know it.

cards.name: Draculious
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText:
I was the only one who was granted an audience with him. That may be because I was from another world. One of the nobles who rule this land looked down at me and opened his mouth slowly.
-From the 3rd paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The PhantomBull Smowg
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can target an opposing Spirit with only one core on it and attack it.

cards.flavorText: The traitors' regretful souls came back to life as evils that were burning with hatred.

cards.name: The Ripper Headiless
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return this Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: They never die. The royal soldiers don't know how to die.

cards.name: The PhantomDragon Sheyron
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Leaving only one core each on every Spirit, and send all other cores from them to their owner's Reserve.
This Spirit can't be blocked by Spirits with only one core on them.

cards.flavorText: The king of the snake attacks and destroys without discrimination. If I had known, I wouldn't have joined hands with him.

cards.name: The Witch Naja
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Only the blood relatives of the snake can stay out of the curse of the evil world. The others are entirely dependent on her, no matter what cost they need to pay.

cards.name: The PrincessVampire Vampiles
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Destroy an exhausted Spirit you or the opponent controls.

cards.flavorText: The merciless queen doesn't care about the evil world or traitors. She gives eternal sleep even to the people who are asking for her help.

cards.name: The PhantomKnight Nightrider
cards.jpName: 幽騎士ナイトライダー
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Destroy an exhausted Spirit you or the opponent controls.

cards.flavorText: The traitorous knight shows up cutting the shadow. He reaps the target's life with a single blow and disappears into the darkness.

cards.name: Beatbeetle
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: If you wander in the woods, you'll see them here and there. They seem to have no interests in the World Tree. I wonder if they ever want to try the fruit.

cards.name: Flyingmirage
cards.jpName: フライングミラージュ
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText:
When I was wandering the humid woods, a black shadow flew over my head. It kept flying swiftly between the dense tree branches. I wonder if the World Tree is really in these woods?
-from the 1st Paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

cards.name: Pelileaf
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While there is any core in your Reserve, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: I thought you were tasting it, since your mouth is so full. But, I guess you are not.

cards.name: Leavwolf
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit card can be summoned from the Hand during Flash Timing. When you do, cores to be put on this Spirit and its cost must be paid from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Didn't I warn you that these woods were alive? So, that's your fault.

cards.name: Shockeater
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText:
It was a weird feeling. Obviously, a tree is talking to me. I looked back and saw the guide's face. He stuck out the tip of his tongue like a mischievous kid.
-From the 2nd paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Emeant
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: During this turn, give all your Spirits +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Even you guys are a good meal for them. So, be careful. They'll take you to their nest while you're sleeping.

cards.name: Matchra
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: The opponent discards a card from their Hand.

cards.flavorText: Ever since the World Tree bloomed, the woods have changed a lot. Don't breathe too deep. Their spores are bad for your throat.

cards.name: Gularva
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When cores would be put onto this Spirit via a Spirit/Nexus/Magic effect, puts +1 core.

cards.flavorText: Do you know the word "Mimicry"? They pretend to be plants and eat the prey before they know it. Most Spirits in these woods are like that.

cards.name: Hercules-Geo
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: There are many different kinds of people trying to find the World Tree. Especially violent ones. I forgot his name, "The Duke something" and his henchmen. The Elders were planning to do something against them.

cards.name: Shidafukurou
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When the opponent would draw cards from the deck, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Once you inhale the pollen of the World Tree, you will start sprinkling the pollen yourself. It's really a bother, don't you think?

cards.name: Eagrass
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: During this turn, all your Spirits gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Eagles are said to be envoys of the World Tree. Why don't you follow them? It might lead you to the World Tree.

cards.name: Apewhip
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Those guys have been shut up in these woods for the evil deeds that they had done all around the forest. However, it seems that they haven't learned anything at all.

cards.name: Hungrytree
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: The opponent discards a card from their Hand.

cards.flavorText: That tree ate some guys who mistook it for the World Tree. I would say, we should never be too greedy!

cards.name: Emeraldscissor
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: They are brutal, but their jaws make good medicine. Of course it wouldn't be easy to break them off.

cards.name: Ziga-Wasp
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit card can be summoned from the Hand during Flash Timing. When you do, cores to be put on this Spirit and its cost must be paid from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Their needles stick to our body and have a scent that draws a swarm. If I were you, I would stay away from them.

cards.name: Killikabut
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to a Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText: They're the cleaners of the forest. They put the field back in order where others messed up.

cards.name: Stagrove
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to another Spirit.

cards.flavorText: They have been protecting the creatures in these woods from a long time before the World Tree came into existence. They should be a lot busier now.

cards.name: Swallowivy
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Reveal five cards from your decktop. If there is any Nexus card among them, choose one and add it to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

cards.flavorText: When people have trouble finding food, they always helps them. They're the friends of the Elder.

cards.name: The BlastTiger Tigald
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit card can be summoned from the Hand during Flash Timing. When you do, cores to be put on this Spirit and its cost must be paid from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Can you run faster than the wind? If not, don't make them mad. They're so upset with people who mess up the woods.

cards.name: The AirMaster Aquilers
cards.jpName: 征空の翼アクィリーズ
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to one of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They say that he ate the fruit of the World Tree and that's why the eagles fly for the World Tree.

cards.name: The MeteoriteArmor Monoqueiroz
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: During this turn, all your Spirits gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Do you believe in eternal youth and immortality? The thing is, there are some people who do believe. What's more, they are all extremely rough and violent.

cards.name: The Charger Blanboar
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The other day, we saw a guy scattering rowdies alone. Everyone in the forest was cheering him on.

cards.name: Gowsilvia
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each core in your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: The closer we get to the World Tree, the stronger this guy gets. So, we must be getting close...

cards.name: The GaudyFeather Vulpelture
cards.jpName: 極彩鳥ヴァルペルチャー
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit card can be summoned from the Hand during Flash Timing. When you do, cores to be put on this Spirit and its cost must be paid from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Isn't that beautiful? But, be careful. That is a bait for his meal. Trust me. You'd better stay away from it.

cards.name: Berserker-Gun
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: Are they alive? Or are they machines? The odd beings came from the distorted gate floating in the sky. They are blanketing the world.

cards.name: Icemaiden
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: He is an invader from another world. The roaring sound from his body transforms the field in reaction. The color of the lives are fading away little by little.

galleryImages.caption: Icemaiden opens a missile launcher on its chest

cards.name: Ray-Bullet
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While you control any "Armored Dragon" family Spirit, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Someone found a distortion in a vacant place. The invaders came from another world through the distortion to bring an end to this world.

cards.name: Baby-Loki
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
I attacked him with all my strength, but it was blocked completely with his hard shell. I stepped back to run from the monster's sharp fangs.
-From the 4th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The AutoLady Mani
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Send a core from your Trash to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Shivering body of glass. The girl keeps working even with her body undermined. Just for the one who supports the world.

cards.name: Rainbowpapillon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While you control any Green spirit, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The lights of tiny insects lead them to the fascinating green lands which are slowly disappearing.

cards.name: Fenrircannon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The beasts that bring destruction to the collapsing world. They press down the resistance and seek the eradication of life.

galleryImages.caption: Fenrircannon taken by a shot of Draculious' bolts

cards.name: The SilverScale Nithhoggr
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +4000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Gentle dragons who love peace. They confront the invaders with their silver body.

cards.name: Ur-Dine
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
"The world is dying." She said in a desperate voice over the silent back of the companion. "The humans and the earth both have lost the energy."
-From the 3rd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Rabicrysta
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't be blocked by Red Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They search for the invaders' activities using their invisible bodies.

cards.name: Gatlingstand
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: Each of the invaders has a different assigned command. He is supposed to march demolishing everything he sees.

cards.name: Elephantite
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: They are the wretched resistance. They lost their lives one by one in fighting against the overwhelmingly powerful invaders.

cards.name: Queen-Valkyrie
cards.jpName: クイーン・ワルキューレ
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't become the target of opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
The blazing flame didn't burn the opponent that time. The Flame Dance that I once had earned in another world vanished in vain.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Metaldy-Bug
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Target a Spirit on each player's Field. Send a core from each of such Spirits to its owner's Trash.

cards.flavorText: The world has stopped moving. The winds don't blow and waves don't crash. The glow insects are just waiting to become shiny stones.

cards.name: Towermittcrab
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each Nexus you control.

cards.flavorText: They are the watchers of this world. They watch out for the invaders keeping still.

cards.name: Dualcannon-Bell
cards.jpName: デュアルキャノン・ベル
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: They are the guards of the gate of distortion. The gate of distortion comes and goes most unexpectedly. So, do they.

cards.name: Hell-Blindi
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return a Spirit to its owner's Hand.

cards.flavorText: The one who fires lightning. He is a natural enemy of the flying whales. The ones who live on the back of the flying whales must run around when they face him.

cards.name: The Artifact Laguna
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your White Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The united intruders who are good at tactics. Taking the leader is the first thing you need to do to win.

cards.name: The CarrierWhale Mobileflow
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)
cards.flavorText: His mission is to protect the small lives. He glides the sky with them on his back.

cards.name: Gran-Dolbalkan
cards.jpName: グラン・ドルバルカン
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: By sending one core from your Reserve to your Trash, immediately end the battle.

cards.flavorText: Joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure. All life was silenced as the invaders appeared over the world.

cards.name: The ArmoredBeast Bear-Gelmir
cards.jpName: 鎧装獣ベア・ゲルミル
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While the opponent controls no Red Spirits, this Spirit can't attack.
All your Green Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Burning rage motivates him to protect the green lands until his body stops completely.

cards.name: The AutoEmpress Sol
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: If it is the opposing turn, skip the Attack Step. Or end it.

cards.flavorText: The glass throat invents beautiful songs that restore the world. Her songs are the only hope we have left on this world.

cards.name: The SteelWyvern Valkyrious
cards.jpName: 飛龍ヴァルキュリウス
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +6000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The body has been possessed by them. However, that's not enough to make him lose his hope. He keeps fighting against the invaders for his pride.

cards.name: The Burning Battlefield
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your attacking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
The opponents must block your first attack this turn if possible.

cards.flavorText:
The first battlefield where the battle between the dragons and dinosaurs occurred. The smell of blood drives even my heart to fight.
-from the Places of Interest 223/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Canyon Where Sage lives
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You draw +1 card. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
You draw +1 card.

cards.flavorText:
The surfaces of the walls are filled with old paintings. The history of this world has been stored in this place by a clan.
-from the Places of Interest 13/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Canyon Where Sage lives — Card Art
The Canyon Where Sage lives — Alternate Art
The Canyon Where Sage lives — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Ruby Sun
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When using a White card, unless the player pay one extra cost, it can't be used.
Besides via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when cores are put onto, or removed from a White Spirit, exhaust it.

cards.flavorText:
The 2nd sun summoned by the dragons which refuses the night and forces people to keep being active.
-from the Places of Interest 531/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Ancient Dragon Territory
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When a Spirit is destroyed, send the cores on that Spirit to its owner's Trash, instead of the Reserve.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The place where dragons used to live. The dragons worship this place and the dry winds still carry the traces of those dragons.
-from the Places of Interest 325/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Ancient Dragon Territory — Card Art
The Ancient Dragon Territory — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Lost of Old Castle
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your Purple Spirits gain +1000 BP.
If both players have the same number of cards in Hand, or the opponent has more cards than you, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The castle of a ruler before the law of evil world was established. Now it's a forbidden area and no one can enter. If you wish to see the inside, sneak in on your own responsibility.
-from the Places of Interest 411/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Lost of Old Castle — Card Art
The Lost of Old Castle — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Swamp of Drain Life
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Send all cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash.
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The swamp which takes lives of people who come close. They say that it has many bodies of nobles from the evil world in its depths.
-from the Places of Interest 412/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Swamp of Drain Life — Card Art
The Swamp of Drain Life — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spirit is exhausted, draw a card.
By sending a core from this Nexus to your Trash, destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked after this battle ends.

cards.flavorText:
The first and the last revolt against the nobles of the evil world. The outcome may easily be guessed.
-from the Places of Interest 224/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
cards.wikiTitle: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed

galleryImages.caption: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed — Card Art
The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Shackles of Doom
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Spirits with only one core on them can't attack/block.
After attack declaration, a core must be sent from the Spirit that attacks to the Trash.

cards.flavorText:
The grave of one of the Seven Shoguns who appeared in this world first. Has he been slumbering here waiting for a day of reincarnation.
-from the Places of Interest 444/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Shackles of Doom — Card Art
The Shackles of Doom — Alternate Art
The Shackles of Doom — Alternate Art

cards.name: The Hermit Wise Tree
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: For each exhausted Spirit you control, all your attacking/blocking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
Refresh all your Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
The Hermit Wise Tree which has been there since the initial stage of the woods. It told us a secret of the World Tree. I wonder if it survived the mass destruction by the Duke.
-from the Places of Interest 8/1000 or "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by the opponent, draw a card.
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
They say that the fruit of the World Tree gives an eternal youth and immortality to the people who eat it. What do they lose in return?
-from the Places of Interest 118/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Anthill
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

When only the opposing blocking Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh the attacking Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText:
The big colony of the Emeants. Seeing Emeants coming in and out from the tower is pretty spectacular.
-from the Places of Interest 801/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Hill of Violent Wind
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Refresh a Spirit with [High Speed you control.
When your Spirit is summoned, during this turn, it gets +1000 BP.] -

cards.flavorText:
A small hill which commands a good view of the entire woods which people believe to be the origin of the World Tree. A view of the woods will give you a better understanding of how unique it is.
-from the Places of Interest 802/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your blocking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
Target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack this turn.

cards.flavorText:
The field of ice that never melts and is not cold at all. Ever since the invasion, it became an ice that isn't ice.
-From the Places of Interest 126/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Diamond Moon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When blocked by opposing Red Spirits, or when blocking an opposing Spirit, your Spirits get +1000 BP.
Destroy the opposing Red Spirit that battled with your Spirit at the end of the battle.

cards.flavorText:
The other moon that can partially be seen from the gate of distortion. It gives off cold lights as it takes the lives of all the living things.
-From the Places of Interest 612/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Castle of Eternal Snow
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return an opposing Nexus to the opposing Hand.
Return a Spirit to its owner's Hand.

cards.flavorText:
One of the hopes left on that island. it generates the clear singing voice like a glass and hinders any invasions.
-From the Places of Interest 26/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: At the start of the step, send all cores from your Trash to your Reserve.
When your Spirits are destroyed, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
The place has been invaded and changed like a board painted to be a set screen. It looked just like paper-mache that shines in silver.
-From the Places of Interest 256/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The DragonEmperor Siegfried
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.
Put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText: Do you know a spell that turns people into dragons? The dinosaur-slaying hero transforms more and more into a dragon for each enemy he defeats.

galleryImages.caption: Wafers: Brave Choco Snack Full Art by Kankurou (https://twitter.com/kankurou_jp/status/837329264806510594)

cards.name: The SevenShogun Desperado
cards.jpName: 魔界七将デスペラード
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Besides this Spirit, send a core each from every Spirit to the owner's Reserve. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
Send cores from a Spirit to its owner's Reserve until only one core left.

cards.flavorText: The 3rd general from the evil world scattered the plague around this world.

cards.name: The Duke Kingtaurus
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: For each other Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText: He is the one who ravaged the woods. He had changed when he got the beast lance "Gae Bolg" in his hand.

cards.name: The ImpregnableFortress Odin
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: For each Nexus either player controls, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.
All Nexuses can't be destroyed.

cards.flavorText: He is the greatest invader in the history who froze down the biggest city.

cards.name: Yoroilizardon
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] This Spirit is also treated as a Blue Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
This is the first time I've encountered a creature in this dimension as it is being born. Unlike humans who are birthed by their mothers, these beings are created from a vast space of nothingness as gathered clusters of power given life and form. What a wonderful miracle! To show respect to all living beings in this realm, I have decided to name these creatures Spirits.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo.

cards.name: Futabanea
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When your Blue Spirit is summoned, destroy an opposing 2000 BP or less Spirit.

cards.flavorText: He finally makes his appearance after a long hiatus. How long has it been? He has a different air about him, but we're extremely lucky to have him return during these darkest times. Look at him, they even tampered with his body... Their struggle will be their last.

cards.name: The HornDinoman Drakkhen
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
[LV2] (Your Attack Step) All your Spirits with cost reduction symbols of two or more different colors gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: His giant shield is his pride and joy. Hopefully he does not end up just like his shield.

cards.name: The VampireDragon Wybat
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: The opponent must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: I'm getting the feeling that more and more characters I've never seen before are emerging in these parts... Could the gaping vortex that recently opened play a factor in this?

cards.name: The GalaxyDragon Andrometeors
cards.jpName: 銀河竜アンドロメテオス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: You can reveal two cards from your decktop. If any, add an "Astral Dragon" family Spirit card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.
This Spirit is also treated as a Blue Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
Change is inevitable... No matter who wins this war, be it the Dragons of the Shooting Stars or the forces of the Empty Sky, this world cannot escape the changes destined to come.
-from the 15th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The SnakeDragon King-Gorgo
cards.jpName: 蛇竜キング・ゴルゴー
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: All your "Astral Dragon" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.
When your Blue Spirit is summoned, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
{The three servants of those who create the stars in the heavens shall transcend time and space to make their guided advent of destiny...} The three fantastic figures appeared before me, exactly like what happened last time.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The WildBeast Cruger
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Send two cores from your Trash to one of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: It can't be helped if everyone went berserk. Battling endlessly day in and day out... Sooner or later, someone will crack. It's to be expected.

cards.name: The FlameEmperor Agniffon
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Send two cores from your Trash to one of your Spirits.
The symbols of every "Emperor Beast" family Spirit you control becomes two symbols of the same color as the symbol that Spirit already has.

cards.flavorText: Unexpectedly, the Four Emperors have assembled! To lose here will be no laughing matter.

cards.name: The BlazeEmperor Arc
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit, and two opposing Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: This is bad, Lolo! If you get caught up in that, you'll fall into the vortex! Come this way, Lolo!! LOLO!!!

cards.name: Kitsunaby
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
"I wasn't able to meet with my guide, but if I find them, I should be okay; I'm just following behind them after all. I need to see the Dark Snakes once again. What am I able to do before we engage toward an end to this conflict? Now that I learned the whole story behind this world, it's time to start getting some answers.
-from the 2nd paragraph on the final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The ShieldKnight Guardner
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Red Spirit is destroyed, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText: There are those who gave away their body and soul to the Demonkin in order to gain the strength to fight....

cards.name: Bogies
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Send all but one of the Cores on one of your opponent's Spirits to his/her Trash.

cards.flavorText: Do the Armies of Oblivion have a main base of operations? Research has only just begun. The Old Tyrants can't seem to find another method of winning.

cards.name: Mimizukurow
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] When one of your Spirits is Summoned via Immortality, send one Core from any of your opponent's Spirits to his/her Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Doomsday predictions proclaim that an era of change is fast approaching, a concept feared by the entire realm. People assumed these signs were already in motion since the Demonkin first appeared. But could this be a misunderstanding? As of late, other never-before-seen creatures different from the Demonkin have emerged more frequently... Could yet another "change" be happening soon, or is it just a personal hunch?

cards.name: The DarkKnight Bors
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 5 Spirit is destroyed.

cards.flavorText:
What happens when an immortal is swallowed up by the Empty Sky? They slowly rise again, absorbing the lifeforce of their fallen comrades.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The JailBeast Gashabers
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: If you control any 8000 BP or more Spirit, you draw +1 card.
Return a Yellow Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The three fantastic figures appeared before me, exactly like what happened last time.
-from the 5th paragraph of the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The DarkKnight Mordred
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Cost 6/7 Spirit is destroyed, you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash.
When your Red Spirits are destroyed, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.
Both players destroy a non-[Tribute] Spirit they control.

cards.flavorText: The Oblivion Dragons have been defeated... but that was only the trigger to a new form of terror.

cards.name: The DragonPhoenixDeity Baaral
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Cost 3/4/5/6 Spirit is destroyed, you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash.
Increase the level cost of every opposing Spirit by +1.
Send all cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash.

cards.flavorText: Oblivion gives existence to Oblivion and reigns over it... A conclusion rife with contradictions.

cards.name: The DarknessEmperor Zanba
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
Send a number of cores from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve, equal to this Spirit's level.

cards.flavorText: When the Celestial Scythe is wielded by its rightful owner, innumerable lives turn into sparkling stars in one fell slice.

cards.name: Ookuchiba
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a Green spirit as well as a White spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The small fruit was filled with unripened youth. Watched over by these strange birds, I took the fruit to my mouth. It was horrendously bitter, but my empty stomach helped me endure the taste. Just what meaning was there behind those birds watching me? At the time, I couldn't even imagine the answer.
-from the 9th paragraph of chapter Green in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Yamiyanma
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Put a core from the Void to any of your White Spirits.

cards.flavorText: This place will likely become a battleground soon. Troops always gather in swarms where corpses lie. Let's find a way around this place. We must get this weapon to the Bravers, but it will all be for nothing if we die here.

cards.name: The Mononofu Impaler
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (During Opponent's Attack Phase) When a "Blade Beast" or "Soldier" Attribute Spirit on your Field is exhausted, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The Bravers are infamous for being extremely elusive; you never know where or when they'll pop up next. Finding a lost child is far faster than meeting these guys since they're practically leaping all over the forest doing reconnaissance duty.

cards.name: The Viscount Minoba
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.
All your Spirits with [Windstorm] gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
A sudden tempest developed with winds clashing at blinding speeds. Somehow, my guide and I managed to hold on to each other. No matter what happens, I must not let go of this blade!
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The FortressWorm Ralba
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Put a core from the Void each to two White Spirits you control.
This Spirit is also treated as a White Spirit.

cards.flavorText: This way, over here! If we move forward together with this guy, we should be just fine, even if we run into the Rowdy Vandals! He may be a giant, but he's gentle, so there's nothing to be afraid of.

cards.name: The GreatHornCastle Elasmos
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Add one Core from the Void to this Spirit for every "Blade Beast" and "Giant Beast" Attribute Spirit on your Field.

cards.flavorText: The Bravers have been following almost every step of their enemies... This is the final stronghold.

cards.name: The Ninja Sarutobe
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When this Spirit is discarded from the Hand by an opposing Spirit effect, you can summon it, without paying the cost.
The opponent discards a card from their Hand.

cards.flavorText: Is it just me, or does it feel like we're being watched...?

cards.name: The Captain Dreadnought
cards.jpName: 軍艦長ドレッドノート
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.
When your Spirits with [Windstorm] are destroyed by comparing BP, they return to the Field, exhausted.

cards.flavorText: This forest won't last much longer... We'll have to part ways here, Lolo.

cards.name: The JungleEmperor Volza
cards.jpName: 密林の勇者皇ヴォルザ
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, this Spirit refreshes.
Cores can't be removed from the Spirit that is blocking this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
Hearing the term 'Braver' makes me recall frightening memories of the previous world.
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Artifact Galar
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a white spirit as well as a yellow spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The discovery of it was a pure coincidence. It could very well be the final piece of the puzzle. The Dragons, the Rowdy Vandals, the Angels, the Demonkin, the Giants, and the Invaders—just who or what were they? I must see the Dark Snakes once more. I must confirm the evidence I've gathered.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The ArmoredBeast Oozuchi
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirits, refresh a Yellow Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText: The heavens split as the Vanity Deities descend from the skies. Their power is too strong to stand up against. Yet still, there are those who willingly intercept them, believing that a new power will soon be born. A period of unexpected calm develops...

cards.name: The Guardian Hlin
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
Give all your "Ice Princess" family Spirits: Armor Purple/Blue.

cards.flavorText:
Suddenly, I heard the sound of despair. A terrible sound like the shattering of glass erupted from the Singing Diva's throat as she crumpled into the Guardian's arms...
-from the 12th paragraph of chapter White in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The GuardianGiantBeast Galaparzo
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] When a Spirit with only 3000BP or less attacks, neither player loses Life Cores.
[LV2] Ice Wall: Green - (Opponent's Turn) When the opponent uses the effect of a Green Magic, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

cards.flavorText: The watchman of the ridge is like an unshakeable steel wall against both the Invaders' protectors and their enemies. Passing through without permission is unforgivable.

cards.name: The FlyingIronBeast Gale-Fokker
cards.jpName: 飛鋼獣ゲイル・フォッカー
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: If you control any Cost 7 or more Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.
All your Spirits with cost reduction symbols of two or more colors gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The three servants of those who create the stars in the heavens shall transcend time and space to make their guided advent of destiny. What will that destiny be? A time of annihilation where nothing is left standing? Or a time of rebirth filled with the power of life?

cards.name: The LanceKnight Gautr
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by an opposing Spirit, refresh three of your Yellow Spirits.

cards.flavorText: Once an Invader, now he's part of the Singing Diva's advanced guard. He inspires his comrades-in-arms as he awaits the Braver's arrival.

cards.name: The Valkyrie Gna
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Ice Wall: Green/Blue - (Opponent's Turn) When the opponent uses the effect of a Green/Blue Magic, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
[LV2] This Spirit gains +2000BP for every "Ice Princess" Attribute Spirit on your Field.

cards.flavorText:
The song has vanished... but no one has given up, not even the Singing Diva. Therefore, I too made my own decision.
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The GiantBeastEmperor Smidlord
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirits, and your Life is three or less, you can summon this Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
All your "Giant Beast"/"Hunter Beast" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: he Singing Diva's vessel miraculously survived the crash landing. The savior was a giant form who thrust himself to get pinned beneath the ship as an emergency sacrifice.

cards.name: The BlizzardEmperor Ullr
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
The attacks of Cost 4 or less Spirits can't reduce either player's Life.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White/Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: A world that has lost its song now turns to the last remaining rays of light.

cards.name: Pooka
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a Yellow spirit as well as a Purple spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The actions of the Fairies that lost their kingdom were nothing short of remarkable. Their deeds aren't necessarily connected, but under the Queen's command, they have enlisted themselves as reinforcements for other kingdoms, fought against the enemy, helped in evacuations, and searched for the Keys.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The LilybellFairy Tinka
cards.jpName: スズランの妖精ティンカ
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (During Opponent's Attack Phase) When your opponent uses a Spirit or Magic effect that targets any of your "Fairy" Attribute Spirits, you can make it such that those effects only affect this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: It appears that the Fairy Queen is hiding something... I wonder if her underlings know what that secret is.

cards.name: The Detective Pentan
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: By discarding [Character Lost] from your Hand, choose a random card from the opposing Hand, and look at its content.
Return a Purple Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: He says he has a lead on the Key's whereabouts.... Oh, never mind, it's nothing. Probably not worth listening to.

cards.name: Iwasaal
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Exhaust two opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits.
This Spirit is also treated as a Purple Spirit.

cards.flavorText: He may be violent, but he's a great help in times of emergency. Let's pass on the Beast Kingdom and move on to the Magic Kingdom; there we may find some tools to help in our research, or at least some weapons to protect ourselves.

cards.name: Aspidochelun
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
Was I mistaken in my judgment? All the beasts that I had tried to help pierced me as an enemy blade.
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The FairyKnight Peter
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
Target an opposing Spirit. During this battle, that Spirit can't block.

cards.flavorText: It's not that I detest handsome men; I'm just not interested, that's all.

cards.name: Clockdile
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned) Destroy all opposing Spirits with Assault.
[LV3] (When Destroyed) Return a Purple/Yellow Magic card from the Trash to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: He carries a bomb inside his stomach. Obviously he shouldn't work himself too hard considering the potential danger, and yet he still wants to do his best despite the situation... I understand how he feels.

cards.name: The FairyPrincess Hama-Dryas
cards.jpName: 妖精の姫巫女ハマ・ドリュアス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV3] All of your "Fairy" Attribute Spirits gain the following effect: (When Attacks) When determining the battle's outcome, if the opponent's blocking Spirit is at Level 1, treat the situation as if you were never blocked, ignoring Battle Point difference.

cards.flavorText:
"It's no use... My consciousness is... My life was just saved not too long ago...."
-from the 13th paragraph of chapter Yellow in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The ShiningEmperor Ryute
cards.jpName: 光輝の勇者皇リュート
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
All opposing Spirits that are blocking your Spirits are treated as LV1.

cards.flavorText: Leave the battle to the professionals; in the meantime, we need to find those Keys!

cards.name: The Gatekeeper Alparkar
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Treat this spirit as a blue spirit as well as a green spirit.

cards.flavorText:
Four of the Six Gem Realms are experiencing the same widespread assault. Feeling concerned, I went to the castle to warn the authorities on the recent events; of course, I was denied entry. It didn't matter that this could be the fifth such incident. Now that I look at this place, this realm has a high cultural level of civilization. I could run the risk of getting arrested for 'spouting nonsense'... Perhaps I should give up on my warnings.
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The SharkMan Sangojaw
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] Spirits can't be refreshed by Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: The fact that he is a former arresting officer is not just for show; even those with greater strength than him cannnot escape his iron grip.

cards.name: The BombBeast Bonnacorn
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) When you have a Green Spirit on your Field, destroy one opposing Spirit with a Core Cost of 2 or less.

cards.flavorText: Unfortunately, I bear disparaging news: it appears the Northern Lands are under the control of the traitorous Western Kingdom. The North's machine craft techniques, the pride of the region feared by many, have now fallen into the hands of the Oblivion Armies. For the first time in the history of the Automaton Tournament, Northern artificial soldiers reign supreme in all the top ranks. I can only hope and pray the balance of power does not shift greatly..

cards.name: The FlameLizard Cthughma
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: This Spirit can block opposing Spirits with "can't be blocked" effects.
Destroy an opposing Spirit with "can't be blocked" effects.

cards.flavorText: What's this?! He wrapped his own body in flames! Such genius! He must have gained this new strategy in Battle Ball.

cards.name: The Diva Canary
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Nexus is deployed, put a core from the Void onto this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Feast your eyes upon this glorious dance! Sure, fierce contests that make your muscles tense and your blood boil can be wonderful, but the truth is oftentimes they are quite indecent. This is more like recreation for the eyes.

cards.name: The DragonArmorGiant Ozias
cards.jpName: 竜鎧の巨人オージアス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV2] All the Nexus on your Field are treated as being at Nexus Level 2.

cards.flavorText:
The Bravers are naturally some of the strongest Spirits even in this realm. My attempt to warn others of recent events didn't go so well, but what regrets I have are far too little to worry about.
-from the 11th paragraph of chapter Blue in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Forest-Golem
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: If you control any Green Spirit, destroy opposing Cost 3/4 Spirits, one of each.
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

cards.flavorText:
Why is this...? As strong as the Sapphire Spirits are, they should be able to win against the forces of Empty Sky easily... Instead they waste their energies in killing each other, forcing them down the spiraling path to certain self-destruction...
-from the 12th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The BlacksmithKing Cyc-Bros
cards.jpName: 鍛冶王サイク・ブロス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Crush (When Attacks) Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) For each card discarded by this Spirit's Crush effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The Blacksmith King, whose brute strength and reputation far outclass those of his automated warriors, sallies forth! After suffering defeat in the first round of the Automaton Contest, his battling prowess is only paralleled by his sheer determination to adapt and learn from his mistakes.

cards.name: The StormEmperor Coyo
cards.jpName: 蒼嵐の勇者皇カイオー
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 3 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
This Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: How come this warrior never participated in the tournaments? If he entered, he would easily wipe the floor with the competition with record-breaking results.

cards.name: The Reincarnation Valley
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: At the start of the step, by discarding a Spirit card with [Tribute] from your Hand, you draw +1 card.
All your Spirits with [Tribute] can't be returned to your Hand by opposing Spirit/ Nexus/ Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
A valley where the Dinosaurs head toward in their final moments; it is there where the dead are reborn with a new life.
-from the Places of Interest 30/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Star Creation Place
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Give all your 8000 BP or more Spirits the effect: "[Clash] (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible."
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit, return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The place where a certain Dragon gained immense power upon his reincarnation. From that moment on, this site has become sacred ground for all Dragons.
-from the Places of Interest 123/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Star Creation Place — Card Art

cards.name: The Shadow Hiding Clock Tower
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Every Spirit with Immortality you control gains +1000 BP.
[LV2] Give all your Spirits with Immortality the effect: "Curse (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit that battled with this Spirit at the end of battle."

cards.flavorText:
An indestructible clock tower that never keeps time. Sometimes, its hands suddenly start moving; rumor has it that someone will die soon when this happens.
-from the Places of Interest 44/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Shadow Hiding Clock Tower — Card Art

cards.name: The Grimoire Bookshelf
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When the opponent uses a Magic effect, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.
You can return a card from your Hand to the decktop. If the opposing deck has 0 cards, this effect don't activate.

cards.flavorText:
A forbidden tome that holds the many records of the Dark Snakes dating back to ancient times. Its contents are shrouded in mystery, but perhaps an even greater enigma is how the Dark Snakes managed to write any records at all, what with having no arms....
-from the Places of Interest 204/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Jade Shrine
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Every "Blade Beast" family Spirit you control gains +2000 BP.
The number of cores on your Spirits can't become less than their LV1 cost.

cards.flavorText:
A shrine erected to worship the spirits who created these forests. Actually, one can find many shrines like this spread out in one single forest, resulting in diverse architectural styles.
-from the Places of Interest 28/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Green Big Tree
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When your Spirit with Windstorm is summoned, exhaust an opposing Spirit with the same cost as that Spirit.
[LV2] (Either Attack Step) You target which Spirit(s) the opponent exhaust due to Windstorm.

cards.flavorText:
As the oldest tree in the forest, at first many believed this to be the legendary World Tree. A miraculous marvel, this tree cannot break, be cut down, or catch flame.
-from the Places of Interest 280/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Green Big Tree — Card Art

cards.name: The Sanctuary protected by GiantBeast
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When "Giant Beast"/"Hunter Beast" family Spirit blocks an opposing Spirit, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.
[LV2] (Your End Step) Refresh every "Giant Beast"/"Hunter Beast" family Spirits you control.

cards.flavorText:
A legendary sacred site said to imbue power to those who still have life in them. There are those who made the effort to escort the Singing Diva to this location, but collapsed during their journey. How deeply regrettable....
-from the Places of Interest 616/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Sanctuary protected by GiantBeast — Card Art

cards.name: The Spring of Norn
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn) You can exhaust a Nexus you control instead for the Ice Wall of your Spirits.
[LV2] Your White/Yellow Nexuses cannot be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
A mysterious spring said to help one fully recover one's power. The hints to everything were right in this spot.
-from the Places of Interest 506/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Spring of Norn — Card Art

cards.name: The Flower Palace
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn) When your "Fairy" family Spirits is destroyed, by sending a core from that Spirit to the Trash, it returns to the Field, exhausted.
[LV2] (Either Attack Step) Opposing Nexus cannot be exhausted.

cards.flavorText:
Just as the name implies, this is a palace made of flowers. Some may say that the word 'Märchen' was invented just for a place like this, and it'd be hard to argue. It's a delightful place.
-from the Places of Interest 70/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Flying Ark
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) When you put cores to your life due to Holy Life effects, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a Magic card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order you wish.
[LV2] (Either Attack Step) All of your Magic cards gain 1 additional Yellow cost reduction symbol.

cards.flavorText:
It emerged beyond the Gates of Heaven when the Seven Keys were assembled... A vessel of the Angels, by the Angels, and for the Angels.
-from the Places of Interest 722/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Great Workshop of the Meisters
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your "Creator" family Spirit becomes exhausted, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
[LV2] (Your End Step) By using the cores on your Field, you can deploy a Green/Blue Nexus card from your Trash.

cards.flavorText:
A factory complex managed and operated with the full strength of the Northern Country. As the nation's second designated capital, this is the project city where the finest artisans of machinery in all the Sapphire Realm gather.
-from the Places of Interest 109/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
cards.wikiTitle: The Great Workshop of the Meisters

galleryImages.caption: The Great Workshop of the Meisters — Card Art

cards.name: The Awakening Fortress Castle
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Deployed) You can summon a Cost 4 or less Blue Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects do not activate.
[LV2] (Your Draw Step) At the start of this step, by discarding a Nexus card from your Hand, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

cards.flavorText:
A moving castle created by the artisans of the North. Many believe that other such automatic mobile vessels, such as trains and airships, also exist, even though they are rarely seen.
-from the Places of Interest 292/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Awakening Fortress Castle — Card Art

cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: During this turn, the cost of all "Astral Dragon" family Spirit cards in your Hand become the same number as your Life.
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

cards.jpName: エグゾーストネクサス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: For each exhausted Nexus the opponent controls, destroy an opposing Spirit without [Tribute]. When this Magic card is discarded from your deck due to opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, immediately activate this effect, without paying the cost.

cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Main - Target a color of Spirits. During this turn, your "Fairy" family Spirits can't be blocked by opposing Spirits of the targeted color.
Flash - During this turn, give a Spirit +4000 BP.
