cards.jpName: トランスフォーメーション
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Flash- Target a Nexus you control with at least one core on it. During this turn, that Nexus loses its effects as Nexus, and is instead treated as a Spirit with (Cost 5/"Artificial Soldier" family/LV1: 1 core, 6000BP/No printed effects).

cards.name: Blessing Cores
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Main- Put a core from the Void each to two of your Nexuses.
Flash- During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

cards.name: Dragonic Howling
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: Flash- Discard a card from your decktop. Destroy every opposing Spirit with the same Cost as the discarded card.

cards.name: The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova
cards.jpName: 超神星龍ジークヴルム・ノヴァ
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 6 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
When the [Tribute] was a "Siegwurm"-named Spirit, put cores from the Void to your Life until you have five Lives.
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP.
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: You're all we can count on!! Please save us! Save this world!!

galleryImages.caption: Alternate version with block icon 1 (Music Deck the Best)
Alternate version with block icon 1 (Wafers - The Legend of Crimson Dragons)
Alternate version with block icon 5 (Memorial Carddass Set)

cards.name: The SevenShogun Beldegaulle
cards.jpName: 魔界七将ベルドゴール
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: This Spirit card in your Trash can be summoned when your Cost 4/5 Spirit is destroyed.
Destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 4 or less Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The last of the Seven Underworld Generals is actually smaller than imagined, but it soon becomes evident that those who are fooled by his appearance are in for a world of hurt.

cards.name: The DoomKnightLord Ragna-Rock
cards.jpName: 終焉の騎神ラグナ・ロック
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all core from a Cost 6 or more Spirits you control to the Void.
Exhaust every opposing Spirit. If "The IronKnight Yggdrasill" was the [Tribute], also, put six cores from the Void to this Spirit.
Refresh three Cost 8 or less Spirits you control.

cards.flavorText: Incredible! He tore off the leader's wings!

cards.name: The ImpregnableKnightLord Odin Type-X
cards.jpName: 要塞騎神オーディーンType-X
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: If the opponent has six or more cards in Hand, return three opposing Spirits without [Tribute] to the decktop in any order.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: The Invader who vanished from the threshold returns, enveloped in a divine radiance.

galleryImages.caption: The ImpregnableKnightLord Odin Type-X — Card Art
The ImpregnableKnightLord Odin Type-X — Alternate Art

cards.name: The MagicalEmpress Ambrocius
cards.jpName: 魔導女皇アンブロシウス
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirit, return a Yellow Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.
When you or the opponent uses a Magic card, this Spirit refreshes.
You can use Yellow Magic cards from your Hand/Removed Zone without paying the cost.

cards.flavorText: Such overwhelming power... Nothing less expected from the Queen of the Magic Kingdom!

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Premium Heroines BOX version

cards.name: The HeelGiant Titus-the-Black
cards.jpName: 凶悪巨人タイタス・ザ・ブラック
cards.setName: Crush of Supernova

effects.text: After paying for the summon cost, you must send all cores from a Cost 5 or more Spirit you control to the Void.
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, discard 15 cards from the opposing decktop.
[LV2] (When Attacks) Cores on the Spirit blocking this Spirit cannot be removed.

cards.flavorText: Someone please tell me it's not true!! To think a mighty hero would turn traitor...

cards.name: Veloci-Harpe
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The Solar Militia is gathering its forces for the next planned invasion at the Corpse Skyscraper. Standing at the head of this regiment is… the Sun Dragon Deity!!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Dsungareap
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
This world is one in which thought can take form. That is why living creatures that are not born from mothers exist here. As I named them, they are Spirits. The arriving humans looking to subjugate this world abandon their bodies, descend with their souls alone, and become Spirits in this world. For example, the Dragons.
-from the 1st paragraph of the Final chapter in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The ArmoredDinoman Gaston
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Destroy an opposing Spirit/Brave with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

cards.flavorText:
The Solar Militia, who throw appearance and organization to the wind, have been labeled "guerrilla warfare masters from the jungle." As their loud triumphant cries when they defeat their foes resonate all the way to the Skyscraper where they intend to invade, they're practically telling their location to the enemy! It's a big flaw in their plans...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Dragon-Pheasant
cards.jpName: ドラゴン・フェゼント
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: For each Spirit-condition Brave you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
Every Spirit-condition Brave you control gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: "You don't need my guidance anymore, right? Besides, it looks like you've gotten stronger recently. I'll be joining the 'festivities' with the others. See you, Lolo... I hope you can finish your business soon."

cards.name: The StarHornBeast Unigaunt
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon a Brave card from your Hand in Spirit-condition, without paying the cost.
When a Brave is summoned via this Spirit's effect, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
Purification of a world disrupted by selfishness. Its proud pure white horn pointing to the heavens is the advent of noble will.
—from the Unicorn chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The DragonBrawler Ardi-Baron
cards.jpName: 竜拳士アルディ・バロン
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Every Spirit-condition Brave with no symbols you control and Brave Spirit with one symbol you control gains an extra Red symbol.
This Spirit gains +10000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
He doesn't care whether you're a combatant or non-combatant, or rather he has no interest in such things. He'll strike everything in his sight, whether living or nonliving! He's the most destructive of the Solar Militia!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The FlameDragonDeity Mars-Dragoon
cards.jpName: 炎星神龍マルス・ドラグーン
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
Destroy two opposing Spirits with one symbol.
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two symbols.

cards.flavorText:
Though he has attained the strength of another dimension, his tenacity has not been satisfied at all. To newly gain the power of the Three Astral Kings, he left his castle with haste.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Grand-Dragcastle
cards.jpName: グランド・ドラグキャッスル
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: You can target and attack a Spirit with the highest BP on the opposing Field.
For each "Ancient Dragon" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: My own home was ceremoniously stuck to the biggest Ancient Dragon. How do they have so much trouble with handling the Dragons?

cards.name: Swordoll
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

cards.flavorText:
While I was so nervous that it felt like my heart would jump out of my chest, I read aloud the letter entrusted to me by the Master.
"To the Twelve Deities of the Zodiac. I wish for peace on this world from the bottom of my heart and I am concerned for it. Whether the Solar Militia or Lunar Brigade wins this war, the world will likely not invite a future where all can face tomorrow with hope. I want this beautiful planet to remain in the future. I ask that you lend us your power. -Astronomer Lilia."
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Championship 2013 Memorial Deck Set
Battle Spirits Burning Soul Wafers Vol. 2: The Raid of Ninja Gales

cards.name: Gagamoth
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText: The snakes with weak eyesight rely on the scent of moth wingscales. To meet them, all one needs to do is follow the moths.

cards.name: Mummybird
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Discard every face-up card on the opposing Removed Zone, and for each card discarded, send a core, besides [Soul Core], from the opposing Field/Reserve to the Void.
When this Spirit is exhausted by an opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash.

cards.flavorText:
The eerie wrappings flowing from the coffin stopped the Dinoman in his tracks, and countless birds vied to be first to eat him!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Wafers ~Assault of the Snake Master~

cards.name: The ChariotEmperor Dirgan
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: At the start of the step, by sending any number of cores from this Spirit to your Trash, for each core sent, send a core from an opposing Brave Spirit with two symbols to their Trash.
This Spirit can't be exhausted by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
"That is not something so simple as a carriage, it is a chariot hailing from hell." The frightened handwriting left in the ancient war records miraculously conveys its advancing form to the current day.
—from the Auriga chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The DarkKnight Kay
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 5/6 Spirit is destroyed.
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked this Spirit at the end of battle.

cards.flavorText:
The operation planner of the Lunar Brigade who chose urban warfare, a rare strategist who bears supreme command. He's the one who thought up such scary things as to weaponize a coffin into a mine.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The CorpseKnight Verium
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When your "Zombie" family Spirits are destroyed, for each Spirit destroyed, draw a card.
For each "Zombie" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
Not even a draw is allowed. When the Demonkin were altogether destroyed, the end also came for those without life.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The PlutoDragonDeity Krono-Hades
cards.jpName: 冥王神龍クロノ・ハデス
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
By sending three cores from your Field to the Void, send four cores from the opposing Field to the Void.
Each player targets one of their Spirits. Destroy all Spirits that aren't targeted.

cards.flavorText:
Before the incredible power that controls time, the PlutoSacredBeast was lured and absorbed by the SaturnDragonDeity without being able to resist!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The CorpseGiant Gi-Gasha
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: While there are five or more "Zombie" family Spirit cards in your Trash, this Spirit card in your Hand becomes Cost 3.
Return any number of "Zombie" family Spirit cards, up to a total cost of 13, from your Trash to the Hand.
Exhaust every opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: By lending you a hand, I have broken the law. This is all I can do for you now. This world will end soon. Hurry, Lolo, you must leave and return to your world.

cards.name: Kanshakukorogashi
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
I've somehow managed to complete negotiations with 7 out of the 12 Deities! The 5 remaining Deities are Taurus, Aquarius, Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. The war enveloping all constellations is at last reaching its final stages. There's little time left... I've got to assemble all of the 12 Zodiac Deities or it'll all be for nothing! I've got to hurry!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Jakonezu
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
Whatever the outcome of the battle is, I cannot let the forest not be saved. After passing on the blade, we will take the last secret mission the Elder gave us, to "Let the oldest tree in this forest eat the fruit of the World Tree." "A tree eating fruit?" I said with my head tilted, as a large tree passed by my side. I see, that's how it is.
-from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Kunoichijorou
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
Separate a Brave from an opposing battling Brave Spirit, and only the Spirit would continue the battle. However, the opponent decides how to move the core when separates.

cards.flavorText:
A shadow soars from fragment to giant fragment that the Dragon Brawler is breaking for fun. In the next instant, adhesive white thread spins out and assails the Dragon Brawler. Unbelievably, the Dragon Brawler is being stripped of his armor!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The Spearhead Siberza
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Neither player's life can be reduced by the attacks of Brave Spirits with two symbols.
If this is the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.

cards.flavorText:
Though still unrefined, his superior speed and presence already makes for the number one shine on the battlefield. His unclouded face reminds me of a Braver from the past.
—from the Canis Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Kojuu-Kamakirou
cards.jpName: コジュウ・カマキロウ
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: For each "Shellman" family Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: They can't be called "Rowdy Invaders" anymore. They too are getting desperate.

cards.name: The SunlightMusha Genji-Bolta
cards.jpName: 太陽武者ゲンジ・ボルタ
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: The cores on your "Sun"-named Spirits can't be removed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects.
All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
While walking alone on the battlefield, a Musha warrior inquires something to all he passes. It appears that he is pursuing a quest to decide a match with his fated archenemy. For him, the war is for finding and finishing things with his rival.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The ShinobiMaster Udou
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Windstorm: 2 - (When Attacks) When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.
[LV2] When your Spirits are destroyed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects, refresh all your Spirits with Windstorm.

cards.flavorText: We have no intention of leaving the forest. But Lolo, you cannot stay here. That ninja will show you the way out of the forest. Stay well, Lolo.

cards.name: The EvilJupiterDragon Nobunagard-Sechst
cards.jpName: 木星魔龍ノブナガード・ゼクスト
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
You can summon a Brave card and a Green Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Astral Deity"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit, refresh that Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
This isn't the charisma that I had admired!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Zaneegun
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
My first order of work is to gather information on the 12 Zodiac Deities from the Solar and Lunar forces. Then, I am to find the Deities faster than them, and hold an audience with them. Here's where my skill comes into play: rather than the Deities taking sides with the Solar Militia or Lunar Brigade, I negotiate with them to support the future that Master has thought up.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Uriborg
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
Peace has such a wonderful ring to it. I was delighted, and everyone rejoiced. However, it was all too brief... Due to the first invasion, the realm was frozen, and both the Singing Diva and the Braver were gone. Looking at the people's eyes, you could see that what they had lost was great. All that was left at the end of the victory was a world that had lost all hope.
-from the 14th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The ArtifactGuards Chrysanthe MK-VIII
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Either player's Life can't be reduced by attacks of Cost 0/1/3 Spirits.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
All your [The MoonlightDragonDeity Lunatech-Strikewurm] are also treated as Purple/Green Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
Since that Artifact Guard soldier is here, it means that the Moonlight Dragon Deity must be in this city as well. If either one of them falls, this war will come to an end here and now!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The ArtifactGuards Chrysanthe MK-VIII — Card Art

cards.name: Sailfish
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
All your White Spirits are unaffected by opposing Brave effects.

cards.flavorText:
Radiating seven-colored light and group swimming in the sea of the sunrise's glow, the golden meteor shower grants wishes.
—Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Volans Chronicles—

cards.name: The IceLady Snotra
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When the opponent uses a Green/Yellow Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: We possess a world frozen in time. Our friend Lolo, we wish for you to surpass us and take flight. In other words, this is where we part. We shall send you off now with maiden's song.

cards.name: The Artifact Forseti
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Heavy Armor: Purple/Green - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
[When Braved] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) All your White Spirits gain +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
With him at the entrance of the Skyscraper, breaking through from the front will be difficult. The operation headquarters of the Solar Militia is immediately changing its strategy; they've notified the front lines of using guerrilla tactics to slip into the moonlight.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Mechaniffon
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
Give all your Spirits this Spirit's [Armor].

cards.flavorText:
It's unusual for the Master to send a letter. Hmm... just as I thought! It was almost inconceivable, but Master was the one who broke the seal on the Three Astral Kings! She says it was to buy time, so that the war wouldn't end before my negotiations and spoil our plans. The Master is truly a rare beauty, but she's not picky about the means she uses to fulfill her convictions... even beautiful people have thorns, I suppose.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The HeavyBootsEmperor Vidar
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When the opponent uses a Purple/Green/White/Yellow Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
When you use this Spirit's [Ice Wall] effect, by sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The remaining Invaders took the lead. They gave everything up and left through the gate.

cards.name: Kogumaru
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
The play-biting becomes a clear assault; they have not the slightest idea.
—from the Ursa Minor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The Astronomer Pentan
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: During this turn, give all your "Song Bird" family Spirits the "Astral Soul" family.

cards.flavorText:
When all of the Angels descend, the end will come to the world. The movement of the stars foretell this. It is an altogether ominous prophecy... Though the face of the teller made me laugh.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Phul
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使フル
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: You can send a core from this Spirit to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
At a dangerous point in my travels, when I was crossing over the Ruler Mountains, I became acquainted with a young girl. From what I heard, she has undertaken a dangerous mission for the Moonlight Dragon Deity. She won't regret losing her life if it's for him? I'd like to be told that too.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Phul — Card Art

cards.name: The StarDog Pomeran
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: For each symbol on the opposing battling Brave Spirit, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
In this age of unending conflict, its often-isolated shape traps those who see it into grave confusion.
—from the Canis Minor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Bethor
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使ベトール
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When an opposing Spirit with two symbols attacks, during that battle, treat that Spirit's LV1/LV2/LV3 BP as 2000.
When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits are destroyed, you can send one core from your Field to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
The rumors say that it's due to her that the charisma of the Eight Astral Dragons has fallen to darkness. She doesn't seem like a bad girl... Hm? She's carrying a forbidden spellbook in her arms!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Bethor — Card Art

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Phaleg
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使ファレグ
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: For each "Divine Spirit" family Spirit you control, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, those targeted opposing Spirits can't block.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Suddenly bursting through, carrying out a single-person head-first sliding maneuver. She folds her arms and looks down. That was how we met.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Phaleg — Card Art

cards.name: The ClownPrincess Trickster
cards.jpName: 導化姫トリックスター
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Draw a card, and return a card from your Trash to the Hand.
Destroy an opposing battling refreshed Spirit.

cards.flavorText: We finally see each other again, but it's a little sad that we have to part so soon. But that's fine. We'll meet again for sure!

cards.name: The UranusDragonDeity Slei-Caelus
cards.jpName: 天王神龍スレイ・カエルス
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
When the opponent uses a Magic effect, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
When opposing Spirits are returned to the Hand, for each Spirit returned, put one core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Pluto has fallen, and Neptune absorbs Mercury.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Stagger
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
The Sun Dragon Deity's strong arm turns to flame, and the Moonlight Dragon Deity takes it head on; in the next instant, they change into the Sun and Moon themselves, and begin to overlap and clash like a solar eclipse! Which one will devour the other!? This simply looks to be the countdown to the end of the world. The heavens flash light and dark. The land rises, and the roars precipitating from the sky suppress it. The Sun and Moon have become one... The nova heralding the end envelops this planet.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Hinoki-Golem
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: During this turn, treat all the reduction symbols of Nexus cards in your Hand as [Blue].
All your Nexuses are also treated as Blue Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: What an unexpected situation. Apparently the one responsible for the Master Unicorn's assassination was a Golem.

cards.name: The Hunter Condrad
cards.jpName: 大地の狩人コンドラッド
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: At the start of the step, by exhausting this Spirit, during this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of Brave Spirits with two symbols.
The (When Summoned) effects of all Cost 3 or less Spirits can't activate.

cards.flavorText:
The divine earth inherited from the forefathers lets out a scream for the continuing great war. Knowing of its grief and wishing to end it, his forceful arrow shrieks and pierces through the enemy.
—from the Indus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Shumongo
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon
cards.flavorText:
Was it because they were in a good mood, or was it strategic reasoning? The attacking Western Militia lent their assistance to the allied Central and Southern armies. It may have been the end that this decision beckoned for. A separate force from the Empty Sky approached the Central country from the empty North. But it should have all been fine, as long as the Master Unicorn was alive and well.
-from the 13th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The BlackBeastKing Cepheus
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Treat all your "Beast Head" family Spirits as Spirits with no printed effect.
All your Spirits with no printed effects are treated as being at their highest levels.

cards.flavorText:
The one rampaging at the foremost line of the Solar Militia's vanguard was once king of a large country which boasted great prosperity. Having become involved in the world, his position changed, but his royal demeanor did not.
—from the Cepheus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Nata-Golem
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When the opponent would pay the cost for Magic cards, they can't pay with cores on their Spirits.
Treat this Spirit as a Spirit without printed effects.

cards.flavorText:
Amazing! His agility is enough to match the spider girl's own unique speed! This guy uses a strange technique, too. Kong fu? Kung fu? Whatever it is. In any case, if that pretty guy with the eyepatch hadn't come along, she wouldn't still be alive.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The NeptuneDragonDeity Tri-Mercurius
cards.jpName: 海王神龍トライ・メルクリウス
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
During the next (Opposing Refresh Step), the opponent can only return three cores from their Trash to their Reserve.
When the opponent pays the cost for Magic cards, the cores can't be paid from their Field.

cards.flavorText:
The Neptune Sacred Beast swallowed the Mercury Dragon Deity in one gulp and dove! He's the sole deity of the seas now!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Captain-Orcard
cards.jpName: キャプテン・オルカード
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Destroy every opposing Cost 11 or less Brave Spirit.

cards.flavorText: It looks like the time has come for us to say goodbye. Commentator Lolo, thank you very much. ...Now, I'm going to Galaxy-finish this! Take it away, Captain! See you, and keep up your battle!

cards.name: Amphisbaenar
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Or, negate the effect of every opposing active "Seal"-named Magic.

cards.flavorText:
It's inexplicable how there's absolutely no information regarding the Bull Dragon Deity of Taurus or the Water Carrier Deity of Aquarius...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The ChargingMachineDragon Archaelancer
cards.jpName: 突機竜アーケランサー
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Draw a card, and destroy an opposing Nexus.
By exhausting a Spirit you control, during this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
Attack target established. Hurry to the Skyscraper towering over the buildings!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The Exoskeleton Bone-Loader
cards.jpName: 鎧骨殻ボーン・ローダー
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Return an "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian"/ "Astral Soul" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The Dragon Brawler, caught in a web, was paraded through town as if celebrating his own achievement.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Death-Haze
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Destroy any number of Spirits you control, and draw a card for each Spirit destroyed. However, any (When Destroyed) effects of those Spirits can't activate.
By discarding a card from your Hand, this Spirit returns to the Field, exhausted.

cards.flavorText:
Raising the scythe held in his flexible arm, his enemy is silently decapitated from upon the rooftop.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Oodsutsunanafushi
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: You can discard your entire Hand (at least one card). When you've done so, draw cards from your deck equal to the number of cards in the opposing Hand.
When the opponent draws, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
It isn't strong enough to kill, but its accuracy is 99.8% - the top ranking among both forces combined!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Manekicat
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: You can summon a Green/White Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.
The opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

cards.flavorText:
There's an unusual belief among the Lunar Brigade saying that if you touch this guy's paw before going to the front, you're guaranteed to win.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Gecko-Glider
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: During this turn, the Spirit braved with this Brave can't be blocked.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
The paratroopers that were training on the snowy mountain are being dispatched to the Skyscraper to eradicate the guerrillas.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Jet-Ray
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirit, if your Life is three or less, you can summon this Brave card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
Exhaust two opposing Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
The aircraft of the Solar Militia are being bombed from even higher in the skies! It's the latest model, with homing missiles equipped.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Hydrandea
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Summon three Cost 2 Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost.
When the number of cores on this Spirit is brought to zero by an opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, this Spirit is treated as being destroyed at its highest level.

cards.flavorText:
The Evil Capricornus Deity of Capricorn heard me out! But I got invited to some strange religion...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The DivineBird Thunder-Bird
cards.jpName: 神聖鳥サンダ・バード
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.
When you use a Magic card, after the effect resolves, during this battle, the LV1/LV2/LV3 BP of the blocking opposing Spirits is treated as 2000.

cards.flavorText:
The informant found out during his travels that the worrying truth that the Bull Dragon Deity has been captured by the Sun, and the Water Carrier Deity by the Moon.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Shoggoleth
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Treat this Spirit as a Spirit with no printed effects.

cards.flavorText:
The Neptune Sacred Beast's transformation, and the Pirate King's revival. The oceans are not calm as before.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Vulcan-Arms
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Draw three cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The Solar Militia has sent in heavy street-combat tanks to their frontline! They've formed ranks and are firing their vulcan cannons!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The Birthplace of the Sword
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When you would [Tribute], by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the cores on a Cost 3 "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control are sent to the specified area.
When Braves are summoned, you draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
There is said to be a legendary sword of unknown make and material that can withstand heat of any degree without melting. Collectors expect that the great war will be an impetus for it to appear in this world once again.
—from the Fornax chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

galleryImages.caption: The Birthplace of the Sword — Card Art

cards.name: The Steam-Breathing Mountains
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: When your Spirit is exhausted by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to the exhausted Spirit.
While you control two or less Spirits, all your "Ancient Dragon" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest LV.

cards.flavorText:
A scene so beautiful as to sigh at, unfitting for this cruel world. It's a dangerous place, but even if you must bet your life, you should see it.
-from the Places of Interest 313/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Brigade's Skyscraper
cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

effects.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The setting for the final decisive battle is a skyscraper veiled in darkness that the Lunar Brigade now occupies. Immediately after the fight began, the Solar Militia continued their steady advance, but the Lunar Brigade made the most of their geographical advantage and launched a fierce counter-assault. At that moment, the skies split into two contrasting sides of light and darkness! It seems the end has begun at last...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.flavorText:
Is the sculpture in the mansion where no one can enter the figure of a god or the embodiment of a devil? Nevertheless, as nobody can enter, this is all speculation.
—from the Sculptor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.flavorText:
Was the building encroached by trees, or was it meant to be like this? I can't decide whether it's meant to be a spectacle or was a natural result, but it's worth seeing once.
-from the Places of Interest 880/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

cards.flavorText:
Two giant trees supporting each other. I can't help but see them as the sun and moon. With the sun alone or the moon alone, the world will lose its balance. This very fallen tree is what I envision this world to become, and what should be realized.
—from the Circinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.flavorText:
The warriors of the Lunar Brigade continually bear serious injuries. Ether alone is extracted from the light of the paling moon, and is intensely discharged on their wounds. Their scars are healed in the blink of an eye, and their latent power is drawn out without sparing.
—from the Microscopium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

When your Brave Spirit is destroyed, the Brave of that Brave Spirit remains, and return only the Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText:
Was it made to be wielded by anyone? A treasured sword shrouded in mystery, its origins and purpose are unknown. It appears to symbolize powers of brilliance such as life, the morning, and justice.
-from the Places of Interest 226/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

cards.flavorText:
There are few travelers who are not hurt by the steep triangular crags or the sharp grass. Also, if your luck is bad you may meet a strange angel; it's a dangerous place in many ways.
—from the Norma chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.setName: Roar of the Moon

While you control five or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirits, your Life can't become zero.

cards.flavorText:
The staircase leading to the Heaven's Door. Rather than being able to contemplate happiness on the way to paradise like what one would think, the stairs are so large, climbing them takes considerable effort. Going to Heaven is quite troublesome.
-from the Places of Interest 712/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

cards.flavorText:
The disappeared legendary constellation stands out on the great sail. Now that everything has been completed, it's only a matter of time until the revival of that Golem.
—from the Vela chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.flavorText:
A legendary island where dreams, romance, and adventure meet. Everyone wants to go, but finding the island is difficult. Not only is there the task of finding the island, there's finding the treasure that lies there. Is it two birds with one stone?
-from the Places of Interest 95/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

These two phenomena thought to be polar opposites are simply 2 points drawn on the line of a circle. The more I think about it, the more similar they are.

It shines on a powerful person's head and takes the person's freedom all day and night.
—from the Cassiopeia chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

A cutting-edge apparatus that remains precise no matter how many hundreds of times it appears. No matter the age, its developer would gain much fame and fortune.

The melody of the soul that an angel strums. Its tone captures those who hear it and washes them away. All that remains afterward are pure souls.
—from the Lyra chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

—from the Crater chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

He is in a world surpassing all knowledge.

He is a pagan deity that gathers and revives corpses.

His armor and flashy performance transfix the lines of vision of all on the wargrounds! Nothing less from the Galaxy's Greatest Dandy!

cards.flavorText: Currently, due to the malfunctioning of the machines in the Country of Silver, we cannot reach the place where the Sword is kept.

cards.name: Pegashione
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Return an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. Rush Green (While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next) [Green]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The sword was successfully recovered thanks to the SwordsSaint... The perpetrator is in the midst of fleeing...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Fifth Day of the Tenth Month-

cards.name: The TenSwordMasters Vol-Cougar
cards.jpName: 十剣聖ヴォル・クーガ
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: This Spirit's Brave can't be destroyed.
Once per turn, besides [The TenSwordsSaint Vol-Cougar], refresh a Spirit you control.
While braved to a symbolless Brave, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

cards.flavorText: The Fencer who recovered the stolen sword and once more enshrined it in its original land. Until things clear up, I've entrusted him with the sword.

cards.name: Azara-Burg
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: At the time of the attack, only the Sword was stolen. The other gathered materials were left untouched.

cards.name: The ArmoredFortress Sawback-Turtle
cards.jpName: 機甲要塞ソーベック・タートル
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Rush Green (While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next) [Green]: You can summon any number of Brave cards from your Hand, up to a total cost of 12, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of Braves can't activate.

cards.flavorText: A mobile fortress took us in when we were on the move. Though, I can't stay calm with its random, showy, and extreme movements.

cards.name: The SilverGoddess Arianrod
cards.jpName: 銀の女神アリアンロッド
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Your Life can only be reduced by one by the attack of each opposing Spirit with two symbols or more per turn.

cards.flavorText: A single goddess in a dreary space. Her presence is conspicuous, if only because of how bizarre the scene is.

cards.name: The HighSpeedMachineBeast Oceloader
cards.jpName: 高速機獣オセローダー
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: For each Spirit with [Rush] you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
This Spirit gains +4000 BP. Rush Green (While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next) [Green]: Exhaust every opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

cards.flavorText: A fusion of a machine and a wildness. This is a hybrid beast with both their strong points.

cards.name: Chocorone
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: I'm hallucinating food thanks to my empty stomach. No, this isn't a hallucination, but it doesn't look edible. Wait a second! That isn't food, so don't eat it!

cards.name: Hakkubishin
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Cards can't be discarded from either deck.

cards.flavorText: Most people doubted the very existence of the SwordsSaints. I wonder why they appeared in each of the countries after the abnormalities.

cards.name: The SleepingFlowerFairy Filly
cards.jpName: 眠りの花の妖精フィリー
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: Probably because this area remained mostly undamaged, the fairies continued to lead calm and unchanged lives.

cards.name: Airavata
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is an "Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card, add it to the Hand. If not, discard it.

cards.flavorText: Given the large influence the abnormalities have had over all the countries, the Country of Brass probably has had the most serious problems. With their habitat destroyed, the beasts are rampaging around the country. It's bad enough that we can't even enter the country.

cards.name: The Angelia Miransa
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
It is forbidden for anyone but the Angelias to enter the Country of Yellow Sky.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, First Day of the Fifth Month-

cards.name: Ray-Fawn
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: Though the countries of the world have taken steps towards a council about the danger the world is facing, as of yet they are all on different pages and have not shown any progress.

cards.name: The MadBeast Konton
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: During this turn, treat every opposing Spirit as being on LV1. Rush White (While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next) [White]: Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The Country of Brass... Due to the beasts causing strife, we are still unable to enter...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Eleventh Month-

cards.name: The Angelia Snipal
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] Cards can't be discarded from either deck.
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Charge - Your “BP- effect” decreases 1000 further.

cards.flavorText: An Angelia stationed to guard the country. She is entirely prepared to intercept a target in her sphere of range.

cards.name: The TenSwordMasters Luciel
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.
During the Flash Timing, you can use a Yellow Magic card without paying the cost.
When you use a Cost 3 Magic card, after that effect resolves, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: She has magnificent skill with the sword she swings. Is she too aiming at the Sacred Swords?

cards.name: The Sage Pentan
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When you're using a Magic card, by exhausting this Spirit, treat up to three costs as being paid from your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: I tried asking the sage about this country's sword, but after hearing what he said, I regret to have asked the wrong person... Speak clearly, I'm confused by your cryptic words.

cards.name: Pelldea
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

Give all your Spirits with [Rush] the effect: [Holy Life]. Rush White (While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next) [White]: All your Spirits with [Holy Life] can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with a BP equal or inferior to that Spirit's.

cards.flavorText: Have you lost all reason? You're posing a threat to everybody.

cards.name: The BattleBeast Wao
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: As if preparing for emergencies, even the most savage beasts are tamed and trained.

cards.name: The Defender of Light Adrian
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Your non-Ultimate "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

cards.flavorText:
We've arrived at the Country of Pale Blue. Just as its name implies, the sky is bright blue.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, First Day of the Sixth Month-

galleryImages.caption: The Defender of Light Adrian — Card Art

cards.name: Kramen
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText:
A chaotic land crowded with strange creatures... it is called the Country of Deep Blue...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, First Day of the Twelfth Month-

cards.name: The Warrior of Light Gaius
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Your non-Ultimate "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

cards.flavorText: There was no need to be guided to the sword, for we easily found it. To tell the truth, from the beginning it was being displayed in the strangest of places.

galleryImages.caption: The Warrior of Light Gaius — Card Art
Battle Spirits Sword Eyes Wafers ShineDragon vs. DarkEmperor
Battle Spirits Sword Eyes Gekitouden Wafers
Burning Soul Wafers Vol. 3: The Clash of Sword Skills

cards.name: Minota-Corse
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.timing: [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) The opponent can't activate their White Burst.
effects.text: Rush Red (While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next) [Red]: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: The sea has become more desolate than ever before since the global change. However, the strange beings show a positive attitude towards the increasing chaos.

cards.name: The Fighter of Light Randall
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Your "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

cards.flavorText: The Sacred Swords are all giant, but I didn't expect this one to be so big. The sphere will need to be big too, so we must gather more material.

galleryImages.caption: The Fighter of Light Randall — Card Art
Battle Spirits Sword Eyes Wafers ShineDragon vs. DarkEmperor

cards.name: The Knight of Light Hope
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: After receiving news of those who have appear together with the black orbs since the abnormalities, this country did not shirk in preparing all combatants to execute countermeasures.

galleryImages.caption: The Knight of Light Hope — Card Art

cards.name: Marble-Golem
cards.setName: Sword Generation
cards.flavorText: There are many countries that create inanimate objects, but this one has the most mystery surrounding its power sources.

cards.name: The TenSwordMasters Egbert
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.
When your Spirits with [Charge] attack, the opponent can't activate Red Bursts.
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

cards.flavorText: I had him take the giant sword that I could not carry.

cards.name: The AbyssalEmpress Resscylla
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Rush Red (While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next) [Red]: Return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The Country of Deep Blue covers a large area of ocean. Without the help of the strange beings, we won't be able to find the sword or its materials.

cards.name: Maze-Hydra
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Neither player can use Green/White/Yellow Magic cards.
The opponent can't return cards from their Trash to their Hand. Rush Red (While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next) [Red]: This Spirit gains two Blue symbols.

cards.flavorText: It tempts the wanderers of the sea, leading them even further astray.

cards.name: Gaimimus
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Draw a card, and destroy an opposing Nexus.

cards.flavorText: Rather than braving, it looks more like he's been seized and waved about...

cards.name: The ElectricArtifactDragon Transfer-Dragon
cards.jpName: 電竜機トランスファー・ドラゴン
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Target a family. Destroy two opposing 5000 BP or less Spirits of the chosen family.
You can target and attack an opposing 7000 BP or more Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Gallantly appearing and transforming without delay, then braving. Preparing for a battle, he freely demonstrates his reinforcement capabilities.

cards.name: Baboon-Bone
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Draw a card.
Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked when the battle resolves at the end of battle.

cards.flavorText: A sword filled with malice. I would hesitate to approach it, let alone use it.

cards.name: The ArmoredBattleship Blade-Hind
cards.jpName: 鎧戦艦ブレード・ハインド
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Send a core from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. If the number of cores on that Spirit is brought to 0 by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: You can brave with this? They don't just call it boarding?

cards.name: Bambull
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1] (When Summoned) Exhaust an opposing Spirit.
[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: I can't tell from this distance, but is that the battle form of the new recruit?

cards.name: Akkeshigumo
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1] (When Summoned) Put a core from the Void each to every Spirit with Rush you control.

cards.flavorText: This spider looks very scary at first look. However, it can be relied on to silently handle any invaders.

cards.name: The GunMachine Toradoll
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: Having several patterns of transformation, it can also brave as well. Its high level of adaptability seems to be the major reason that it is used as a part of the main-force.

cards.name: The CannonBeast Aquidry
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Life is reduced, this Spirit refreshes.

cards.flavorText: The search for the thief who stole the sword is still continuing. The daytime search has been entrusted to those that know no fatigue.

cards.name: Kongoushouki
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1] (When Summoned) During this turn, every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit can't block.

cards.flavorText: We took a detour and once again attempted to enter the country. However, they still showed a rejecting gesture.

cards.name: Jackkuri
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) When you use a Magic card, after its effect resolves, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: It looks cute, and then shows its battle potential by braving. Its selling point is its twofold deliciousness.

cards.name: Fuscina-Arms
cards.jpName: フェスキーナ・アームズ
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: During this turn, a Spirit with [Charge] you control is treated as being on its highest level.
Discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

cards.flavorText: A newly produced self-mobilized arm and armament. Its best feature is that it can fight even on its own.

cards.name: The SeaCreature Gulon
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [When Braved] (When Brave Attacks) All Magic cards without Rush in the opposing Hand are treated as having no reduction symbols.

cards.flavorText: I can't tell which part is the main body and which is the braved part. Huh? You say it hasn't braved yet!?

cards.name: The Stargazing Triple Tower
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Cost 2 or more Spirit with [Charge] attacks, draw a card.
When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirits destroy any opposing Spirits, return a Brave card from your Trash to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: Tall and splendid, these giant towers were erected at a spot with an authoritative point of view. That's not all; they also have a practical function as watchtowers.

galleryImages.caption: The Stargazing Triple Tower — Card Art

cards.name: The Bisecting Active Volcano
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Give every "Terra Dragon" family Spirit you control the following effect: "Clash (When Attacks) The opponent must block if possible".
[LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your "Terra Dragon" family Spirits attack, destroy an opposing Spirit with the same BP as the attacking Spirit.

cards.flavorText: According to rumor, the split volcano's appearance was the doing of a SwordsSaint. To prove how strong he truly was, he created this display.

galleryImages.caption: The Bisecting Active Volcano — Card Art

cards.name: The Crumbling Uroko Mountain
cards.jpName: 剥がれ落ちるウロコ山
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your Spirits with Rush are destroyed/returned to the Hand by opposing effects, destroy an opposing Spirit.
[LV2] (Your Attack Step) All your Spirits with "Rush" gain +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: There are those who would try to scale this mountain, but they would repeatedly climb and slip, climb and slip all the way down. I only hope I don't have to climb this mountain.

galleryImages.caption: The Crumbling Uroko Mountain — Card Art

cards.name: The Bone Forest of Wandering Souls
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Spirits are destroyed, draw a card.
Your "Zombie" family Spirits can't be exhausted by opposing effects.

cards.flavorText: On the road from country to country, I have seen many beings crumble to dust.
cards.wikiTitle: The Bone Forest of Wandering Souls

galleryImages.caption: The Bone Forest of Wandering Souls — Card Art

cards.name: The Snake's Castle Gate
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Besides putting cores for summons, exhaust every opposing Spirit that has cores being put onto it.
When your "Dark Snake" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Looking for the swallowing snake, we headed to the snake palace. We finally arrived, but even the door looks ominous...

galleryImages.caption: The Snake's Castle Gate — Card Art

cards.name: The Candle Tower of Life
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Spirits with [Rush] are destroyed by opposing effects, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.
When cards would be discarded from your deck due to the opponent, unless the opponent sends ten cores from their Reserve to their Trash, cards can't be discarded from your deck.

cards.flavorText: The light of candlestick was extinguished from time to time, but nobody tried to rekindle it.

galleryImages.caption: The Candle Tower of Life — Card Art

cards.name: The Pouring Clear Stream
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your Green Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits with Charge.
[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: I must store some of this famously refreshing water for the journey to come. But how should I gather this water here?

galleryImages.caption: The Pouring Clear Stream — Card Art

cards.name: The Shinobi's Hidden Village
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your End Step) Refresh all your Green Spirits.
[LV2] (Your Attack Step) When your "Winged Beast" family Spirit attacks, exhaust an opposing spirit.

cards.flavorText: Having arrived at the Country of Willow, we looked for a place to lodge. As we did so, they invited us to the land where the shinobi reside.

galleryImages.caption: The Shinobi's Hidden Village — Card Art

cards.name: The Stronghold of the Demonic Insect
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When the attacks of your Spirits with [Rush] reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
When summoning a Spirit card/Brave card from your Hand via [High Speed], once per turn, you can summon it without paying the cost.

cards.flavorText: We had to ask the reigning insect lord to get permission to operate in this country. He answered thusly: You have my permission to act, but your life cannot be guaranteed.
cards.wikiTitle: The Stronghold of the Demonic Insect

galleryImages.caption: The Stronghold of the Demonic Insect — Card Art

cards.name: The Beast's Ice Cavern
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Neither player's Life can be reduced by the attacks of 4000 BP or less Spirits.
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing Spirit/Magic effect, for each card increased, you can draw a card.

cards.flavorText: The inside of the impassible ice cavern has two possible outcomes: be attacked by beasts, or die of frost. Thus, nobody knows what happens inside to this day.

galleryImages.caption: The Beast's Ice Cavern — Card Art

cards.name: The Fortress Cube
cards.jpName: フォートレスキューブ
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step) When your White Spirits refresh, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.
[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When your Life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, return one of those opposing Spirits to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: A mysterious six-sided object believed to be a fortress. Wherever you view it from, it doesn't appear to have an entrance though.

cards.name: The Inverse Tower of Frozen Icicle
cards.jpName: 凍てつくつららの逆塔
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Green Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to any of your White Spirits.
When your Spirits with [Rush] are destroyed by opposing effects, return one of the destroyed Spirits you control to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The pillar of ice growing from the water's surface freezes all who touch it.
cards.wikiTitle: The Inverse Tower of Frozen Icicle

galleryImages.caption: The Inverse Tower of Frozen Icicle — Card Art

cards.name: The Ferris Wheel of Heaven Wings
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When opposing Spirits are brought to 0 BP for the first time in the turn, draw a card.
When only your "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to your life.

cards.flavorText: When we visited, I saw a giant ferris wheel. I was surprised at how excited my companion became when riding it.
cards.wikiTitle: The Ferris Wheel of Heaven Wings

galleryImages.caption: The Ferris Wheel of Heaven Wings — Card Art

cards.name: The Feast of the Pastry Forest
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: Cards can't be discarded from either deck.
When your Life is at two or less, instead of putting a core from the Void to your Reserve, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText: There are a great many temptations to forget my responsibilities here. Lead into the forest by the smell, delicious-looking sweets were lined up inside.
cards.wikiTitle: The Feast of the Pastry Forest

galleryImages.caption: The Feast of the Pastry Forest — Card Art

cards.name: The Nekoron Mountain
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Spirits with [Rush] are summoned, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is a Brave card/Magic card, add it to your Hand. If not, discard it.
When only the Brave on your Brave Spirit is destroyed, you can return that Brave to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: Since it looks as if cat ears are growing from the summit, I wonder if it's been nicknamed "Cat Ear Mountain".

cards.name: The Never Ending Aqueduct
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: The (When Summoned) effects of Spirits/Braves can't activate.
When your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit is blocked by opposing Spirits, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: One might be curious as to where the gushing water flows to and gaze at it for quite a while. Truly, as the water flows, so does time.

galleryImages.caption: The Never Ending Aqueduct — Card Art

cards.name: The Lit Three-Pronged Lighthouse
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: You can summon a Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, it can't activate its (When Summoned) effects.
All your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest levels.

cards.flavorText: Multiple beams of light reach out at intervals to illuminate the surrounding area. When they illuminate everything at once, the blinding light blocks the view.

galleryImages.caption: The Lit Three-Pronged Lighthouse — Card Art

cards.name: The Sea Monster Infested Ocean
cards.setName: Sword Generation

effects.text: When your Spirit with [Rush] attacks, treat that Spirit as being one level higher.
The opponent can't activate Red/Green/White Bursts.

cards.flavorText: Just like the changes that occurred in other countries, this sea too has been greatly affected. The raging areas of the ocean and their masters have become much stronger after the fluctuations.

galleryImages.caption: The Sea Monster Infested Ocean — Card Art

When your Life three or less, you can destroy this Spirit. When you've done so, reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of "HeroBeast"-named Spirit cards, paying one cost for each. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

cards.flavorText:
Alex had predicted it was Egyt invading, but the one who appeared in front of her then was Olym's Grandwalker, Hermes.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:39―

cards.name: Hunter-Actaeon
cards.jpName: ハンター・アクタイオーン
cards.setName: Grand Advent Saga Volume 2 – Reincarnating Ultimate Deity

effects.text: When this card is sent to the Trash from deck by the effect of your White Grandwalker Nexus, you can summon it by paying one cost.
When the opponent draws via an effect, you can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
Apollon and Artemis had already been doing their best just to avoid being annihilated. They could only abandon their world and flee to where their allies are.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:36―

cards.name: Pointer-Lemur
cards.jpName: ポインター・キツネザル
cards.setName: Grand Advent Saga Volume 2 – Reincarnating Ultimate Deity

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) When you gain core(s) from the Void via your Core Charge or effect, this Spirit refreshes.

cards.flavorText:
Both Artemis's defensive power and ability to debilitate opponent's defense were amazing. However, the match-up was too bad.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:25―

cards.name: Lailaps-Chaser
cards.jpName: ライラプス・チェイサー
cards.setName: Grand Advent Saga Volume 2 – Reincarnating Ultimate Deity

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent) Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom, and return this Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText:
A machine hunt dog fated to capture whatever it hunts. Artemis was curious regarding what would happen if it faced someone fated to never be caught, so she consulted Hermes.
"Hmm, that sounds interesting. Let's find it out!"
It is said that Artemis actually didn't expect Hermes would really go for such a search.

cards.name: The SevenSisters Maia
cards.jpName: セブンシスターズ マイア
cards.setName: Grand Advent Saga Volume 2 – Reincarnating Ultimate Deity

This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

cards.flavorText: The eldest Pleiades sister. They get rid of any who approach Artemis, but it seems Hermes is allowed.

cards.name: Crocoite-Lizard
cards.jpName: クロコアイト・リザード

cards.flavorText:
Artemis' specialization, protracted warfare, was inversely convenient to Isis, and the Angelias fierceness only increased.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:28―

cards.name: Gunbattery-Ceros
cards.jpName: ガンバッテリー・セラス

Her forces had little tactics to pull against Ultimates prepared, and even her defense, which was supposed to be her specialty, was easily penetrated by Isis.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:26―

With her overwhelming power, Isis' Avatar destroys their escape route.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:35―

She was the one that sent Divine Spirits to the six-colored world that existed before Grand-Lolo was created. Sending her beloved daughters on a voyage fits her style, and all of that is for Horus' sake...

In fact, the records say that Ultimates were first birthed by Egyt's supreme deity, Ra, to begin with.
―"Genesis Records" Volume 2:19―

cards.name: The DruidGirl Bridgette

effects.text: You can discard a card from your decktop. If that's a "Dark Artes" family card, draw a card from the deckbottom.
"Dark Artes" family cards in your Trash are unaffected by opposing effects.

cards.flavorText:
I still don't know why the world changed like this, but there is a way to deal with it. With Alex by my side, we can reconnect the worlds and return everything to normal.
――"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:30―

cards.name: The DruidGirl Marine
cards.jpName: ドルイドの少女マリン

Alex's memories haven't returned, she herself doesn't understand how she created a world.
―"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:31―

If we can make Alex's memories return and let her fully use her powers, certainly we can return the world to normal.
――"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:32―

I don't know where she came from, but I'm sure some god brought her unto this world.
――"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:33―

―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:34―

Alex herself doesn't know how she manifested the power to create an area. In an attempt to stimulate her memories into returning, we visit the Blue World.
―"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:35―

We arrive on a large ocean, and, for starters, decide to see this area's edge.
―"Record of Wordly Matters" Volume 1:36―

The edge of the ocean was a steep plain water surface. Almost as if on an aquarium, it is held in place, without flowing down.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:37―

After seeing the world being distorted before our very eyes, we end up witnessing an even more amazing sight.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:38―

At first, I didn't know what that meant. A giant which brought with himself a mechanical soldier which certainly wasn't a golem did something towards the ocean. Taking a good look, I could notice a hole was opening in the ocean.
―"Record of Worldly Matters" Volume 1:39―

cards.flavorText:
Fenleaf "Lecoulis has just obtained peace, then it is the outside world's turn..."
Frau "I...I want to see with my eyes and experience lots and lost more things with Toa~"
Hitotsume "Sigh. I can't stop this girl anymore. Since when did she become like this?"

cards.flavorText:
Dan, Kai, Toa, and all eighteen partner Spirits. The brave warriors that are going to challenge the final judgment were gathered. And finally, The-Judgment showed itself. However, its form greatly deviated from what it appeared to be last time. It appeared very human, and held a large scythe in its hand. The final battle that would decide Lecoulis' fate was about to begin.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

cards.flavorText:
Lecoulis seems to have overcome the final reckoning of The-Judgment. But what actually happened, is a reconstruction of the entire Lecoulis into a different world that may as well be called "Grand-Lolo-Lecoulis" which happened when the vague memories of Grand-Lolo actualizes via the destruction and creation before and after the final reckoning.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

So this is the new world~ There are so many things I've never seen before~
―The PartnerWolf Lampo―

cards.flavorText:
I've held on to Dan very, very tight~
―The PartnerWolf Lampo―

cards.flavorText:
Stark, who was separated from Dan due to the attack from the Olym Primordial Deities, washed up in Artemis' world. It was a world of Machine Beasts. While walking on a wasteland shone bright in moonlight, a female appeared before Stark. And she was Artemis, the goddess of Moon, and the sister of Apollon.
-"Thenogonic Record" Fragment-

cards.flavorText:
The power of contract...By contracting with Dan, Apollon has held back the primordial deities for a good while. Regretfully, the contract concluded back at that time was incomplete, and hence couldn't last long enough. More research is needed.
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.jpName: 鋼鉄機士ファライコス

cards.flavorText:
Dan, a drifter who could travel across various worlds by his own power. Could that mean he has the same power as us? Although I've heard that his power as a singularity is lost after the Judgment berserk incident in Lecoulis...This is so intriguing.
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.name: The SteelMaiden012 Alcyone
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Volume 1 – Battle of the Gods

cards.flavorText: "Hi, and welcome to Acropolis! This is one of the Steel Cities under the protection of Lady Athena, and it is governed by my elder sister! Hope you can find the clues about Contract Grandwalkers you want in the Divine World Library~"

cards.name: The SteelKnight Stratos
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Volume 1 – Battle of the Gods

cards.flavorText:
Only a few knows about the Primordial Deities...Among the twelve Olympians, only Lord Zeus, Lord Poseidon, and Lady Demeter, the second generation deities know. Lady Hera simply doesn't like the fact that Hades is going to seize the real power...But Lord Poseidon is displaying such a stern attitude, and even Lady Demeter is supporting Hades...Is there something behind all these that we don't know?
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.flavorText:
Excellent! Thank for all your support, everyone from Winglass!
Waltrud "You will pay for the price. Be ready♥"

cards.flavorText:
Hades, who then became the leader of Olym, announced his contract with Dan the drifter. It is settled that contract powers would be used as the main plan to combat against the primordial deities.
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

galleryImages.caption: The SteelKnight OwlUser Ignatios — Card Art

The Steel Knights who survived Divine World War surely looks different. You say they all look the same? Each of them is unique and looks so different though.
―Grandwalker Athena―

Feaniel was separated from Dan due to the attacks of the Olym Primordial Deities. And where she eventually arrived, was Aphrodite's world.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

Ok, understood! Find this guy who is called Dan, and help him out, right? Leave it to me, Creator!
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

Searching for Dan, Kinich-Ahau travelled across various worlds of Olym. As he approached the center of Olym, however, he found that he was interrupted by the primordial deities more and more frequently. And while he was still on the way, Olym had fallen under Hades' control, and it was announced that Hades had contracted with Dan. Hearing that, he immediately headed towards Elies, the world of Hades.
―Thenogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.name: Maimai Measure

cards.flavorText:
Kinich-Ahau, a Grandwalker from Vulrica, sneaked into Olym chasing after Dan. However, Dan was then caught in the fight caused by the Olym primordial deities.
―Thenogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.flavorText: Kinich-Ahau is the Grandwalker of Puppet Beast Spirits that take the form of various tools. DIY is exactly his forte. It is said that he could build even a log house by himself.

cards.name: Bison Jigsaw

Hey, make a contract with me! Contracting with Hades also isn't your first time doing contracts I thought. I want to get stronger!

Ok ok, Plier. Calm Down. Don't keep barking because he is a stranger. So you're Dan? I've heard about you from my brothers.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

So the Olyms have screwed it up, having the primordial deities revived. The balance of the Divine World is probably going to change.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.flavorText:

Taking in the news that Oylm was now in Hades' control, and that he had contracted with Dan, the Olym primordial deities moved. Uranus, a first generation Grandwalker of Olym, then made an announcement.
Uranus "Olym, we're back! It's time for you to return us the world that we, the primordial Grandwalkers, created!"
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

Dan is caught in the war against the Olym primordial deities. Which means that the search for Contract Granwalkers could only be postponed until the war is over. And at this point of time, a mysterious Grandwalker, Kinich-Ahau, suddenly shows up before Dan. What is he after?

What happened during the Judgment in Lecoulis would be recorded here.
