cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve. Exhaust all Spirits/Ultimates that had core moved due to this effect.

cards.flavorText: Only the blood relatives of the snake can stay out of the curse of the evil world. The others are entirely dependent on her, no matter what cost they need to pay.

cards.name: The PrincessVampire Vampiles (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay for the summon cost, also, return a Purple Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The merciless queen doesn't care about the evil world or traitors. She gives eternal sleep even to the people who are asking for her help.

cards.name: The PhantomKnight Nightrider (Revival)
cards.jpName: 幽騎士ナイトライダー
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When your Purple Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
By destroying an exhausted Spirit, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

cards.flavorText: The traitorous knight shows up cutting the shadow. He reaps the target's life with a single blow and disappears into the darkness.

cards.name: Beatbeetle (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: If you wander in the woods, you'll see them here and there. They seem to have no interests in the World Tree. I wonder if they ever want to try the fruit.

cards.name: Flyingmirage (Revival)
cards.jpName: フライングミラージュ
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText:
When I was wandering the humid woods, a black shadow flew over my head. It kept flying swiftly between the dense tree branches. I wonder if the World Tree is really in these woods?
-from the 1st Paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

cards.name: Pelileaf (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: While there is Soul Core core in your Reserve, this Spirit gains +6000 BP.

cards.flavorText: I thought you were tasting it, since your mouth is so full. But, I guess you are not.

cards.name: Leavwolf (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
While there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, all your Spirits with [High Speed] gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Didn't I warn you that these woods were alive? So, that's your fault.

cards.name: Shockeater (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText:
It was a weird feeling. Obviously, a tree is talking to me. I looked back and saw the guide's face. He stuck out the tip of his tongue like a mischievous kid.
-From the 2nd paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Emeant (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: The number of cores on your Green Spirits can't be brought to 0 by the opponent.
During this turn, give all your Spirits +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Even you guys are a good meal for them. So, be careful. They'll take you to their nest while you're sleeping.

cards.name: Matchra (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay for the summon cost, discard a random card from the opposing Hand.

cards.flavorText: Ever since the World Tree bloomed, the woods have changed a lot. Don't breathe too deep. Their spores are bad for your throat.

cards.name: Gularva (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: While there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, all your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect" family Spirits get +4000 BP.
When cores would be put onto this Spirit from the Void via a Spirit/Nexus/Magic effect, puts +1 core.

cards.flavorText: Do you know the word "Mimicry"? They pretend to be plants and eat the prey before they know it. Most Spirits in these woods are like that.

cards.name: Hercules-Geo (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: There are many different kinds of people trying to find the World Tree. Especially violent ones. I forgot his name, "The Duke something" and his henchmen. The Elders were planning to do something against them.

cards.name: Shidafukurou (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When the opponent draws, refresh this Spirit. If there is (Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Once you inhale the pollen of the World Tree, you will start sprinkling the pollen yourself. It's really a bother, don't you think?

cards.name: Eagrass (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Exhaust two opposing Spirits, and during this turn, all your Spirits gain +5000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Eagles are said to be envoys of the World Tree. Why don't you follow them? It might lead you to the World Tree.

cards.name: Apewhip (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Also, if [Soul Core] is used to pay the summon cost, put two cores from the Void to your Trash.

cards.flavorText: Those guys have been shut up in these woods for the evil deeds that they had done all around the forest. However, it seems that they haven't learned anything at all.

cards.name: Hungrytree (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Discard a random card from the opposing Hand. After this effect resolves, if the opposing Hand is five or more, discard two random cards from their Hand.

cards.flavorText: That tree ate some guys who mistook it for the World Tree. I would say, we should never be too greedy!

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Wafers ~The Amethyst-Emerald Storm of Blades~

cards.name: Emeraldscissor (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
The number of cores on your Green Spirits can't be brought to less than two by the opponent.

cards.flavorText: They are brutal, but their jaws make good medicine. Of course it wouldn't be easy to break them off.

cards.name: Ziga-Wasp (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
While there is Soul Core in your Reserve, this Spirit gains +8000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Their needles stick to our body and have a scent that draws a swarm. If I were you, I would stay away from them.

cards.name: Killikabut (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.
Exhaust an opposing spirit.

cards.flavorText: They're the cleaners of the forest. They put the field back in order where others messed up.

cards.name: Stagrove (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to another Spirit you control. By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Reserve, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: They have been protecting the creatures in these woods from a long time before the World Tree came into existence. They should be a lot busier now.

cards.name: Swallowivy (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Green Spirit card or Nexus card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom, in any order.

cards.flavorText: When people have trouble finding food, they always helps them. They're the friends of the Elder.

cards.name: The BlastTiger Tigald (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, also, exhaust two opposing Spirits.

cards.flavorText: Can you run faster than the wind? If not, don't make them mad. They're so upset with people who mess up the woods.

cards.name: The AirMaster Aquilers (Revival)
cards.jpName: 征空の翼アクィリーズ
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They say that he ate the fruit of the World Tree and that's why the eagles fly for the World Tree.

cards.name: The MeteoriteArmor Monoqueiroz (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: During this turn, all your Spirits gain +10000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Do you believe in eternal youth and immortality? The thing is, there are some people who do believe. What's more, they are all extremely rough and violent.

cards.name: The Charger Blanboar (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When the battling Spirit is depleted/destroyed, refresh this Spirit. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText: The other day, we saw a guy scattering rowdies alone. Everyone in the forest was cheering him on.

cards.name: Gowsilvia (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Send any number of cores from this Spirit to your Reserve. When you've done so, for every two cores sent to the Reserve, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
This Spirit gains +3000 BP for each core in your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: The closer we get to the World Tree, the stronger this guy gets. So, we must be getting close...

cards.name: The GaudyFeather Vulpelture (Revival)
cards.jpName: 極彩鳥ヴァルペルチャー
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: While your Life is at three or less, this Spirit card in Hand becomes Cost 3.
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Isn't that beautiful? But, be careful. That is a bait for his meal. Trust me. You'd better stay away from it.

cards.name: Berserker-Gun (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: Are they alive? Or are they machines? The odd beings came from the distorted gate floating in the sky. They are blanketing the world.

cards.name: Icemaiden (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: He is an invader from another world. The roaring sound from his body transforms the field in reaction. The color of the lives are fading away little by little.

cards.name: Ray-Bullet (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: While you control any "Armored Dragon" family Spirit, this Spirit gains +5000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Someone found a distortion in a vacant place. The invaders came from another world through the distortion to bring an end to this world.

cards.name: Baby-Loki (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +3000 BP, and exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
I attacked him with all my strength, but it was blocked completely with his hard shell. I stepped back to run from the monster's sharp fangs.
-From the 4th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The AutoLady Mani (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +3000 BP. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this spirit, also, send three cores from your Trash to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Shivering body of glass. The girl keeps working even with her body undermined. Just for the one who supports the world.

cards.name: Rainbowpapillon (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: While you control any Green spirit, this Spirit gains +8000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The lights of tiny insects lead them to the fascinating green lands which are slowly disappearing.

cards.name: Fenrircannon (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +5000 BP, and refresh another White Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText: The beasts that bring destruction to the collapsing world. They press down the resistance and seek the eradication of life.

cards.name: The SilverScale Nithhoggr (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +5000 BP.
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

cards.flavorText: Gentle dragons who love peace. They confront the invaders with their silver body.

cards.name: Ur-Dine (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

cards.flavorText:
"The world is dying." She said in a desperate voice over the silent back of the companion. "The humans and the earth both have lost the energy."
-From the 3rd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Rabicrysta (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Red/Purple Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They search for the invaders' activities using their invisible bodies.

cards.name: Gatlingstand (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: Each of the invaders has a different assigned command. He is supposed to march demolishing everything he sees.

cards.name: Elephantite (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +5000 BP, and return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: They are the wretched resistance. They lost their lives one by one in fighting against the overwhelmingly powerful invaders.

cards.name: Queen-Valkyrie (Revival)
cards.jpName: クイーン・ワルキューレ
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The blazing flame didn't burn the opponent that time. The Flame Dance that I once had earned in another world vanished in vain.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Metaldy-Bug (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Send one core from any of your Spirit and from any opposing Spirit to its owner's Trash.
Return this Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText: The world has stopped moving. The winds don't blow and waves don't crash. The glow insects are just waiting to become shiny stones.

cards.name: Towermittcrab (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +5000 BP for each Nexus you control.

cards.flavorText: They are the watchers of this world. They watch out for the invaders keeping still.

cards.name: Dualcannon-Bell (Revival)
cards.jpName: デュアルキャノン・ベル
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: They are the guards of the gate of distortion. The gate of distortion comes and goes most unexpectedly. So, do they.

cards.name: Hell-Blindi (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. When [Soul Core] (Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, also, return one of your Spirits to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The one who fires lightning. He is a natural enemy of the flying whales. The ones who live on the back of the flying whales must run around when they face him.

cards.name: The Artifact Laguna (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: All your White Spirits gain +5000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The united intruders who are good at tactics. Taking the leader is the first thing you need to do to win.

cards.name: The CarrierWhale Mobileflow (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor
cards.flavorText: His mission is to protect the small lives. He glides the sky with them on his back.

cards.name: The ShieldSpirit Dis (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When the opponent declares block, return an opposing Spirit, except the one blocking this Spirit, to the Hand. When you've done so, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.
This Spirit remains on Field in the same condition, and refresh another Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText: She looked up at the moon singing a song. She knows that the battles are not the only struggles in this world. Her voice brings lights and lights generate the vitality.

cards.name: Gran-Dolbalkan (Revival)
cards.jpName: グラン・ドルバルカン
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: By sending one core from your Reserve to your Trash, immediately end the battle. When [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is sent to your Trash via this effect, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure. All life was silenced as the invaders appeared over the world.

cards.name: The ArmoredBeast Bear-Gelmir (Revival)
cards.jpName: 鎧装獣ベア・ゲルミル
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Return every opposing non-Red Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
If the opponent controls no Red Spirits/Ultiamtes, this Spirit can't attack.
All your Green Spirits gain +5000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Burning rage motivates him to protect the green lands until his body stops completely.

cards.name: The AutoEmpress Sol (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When your White Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
The Spirit can block while exhausted.
If this Spirit is depleted/destroyed in the opposing turn, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

cards.flavorText: The glass throat invents beautiful songs that restore the world. Her songs are the only hope we have left on this world.

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Wafers ~The Amethyst-Emerald Storm of Blades~

cards.name: The SteelWyvern Valkyrious (Revival)
cards.jpName: 飛龍ヴァルキュリウス
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: This Spirit gains +10000 BP. By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, also, return two opposing 15000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The body has been possessed by them. However, that's not enough to make him lose his hope. He keeps fighting against the invaders for his pride.

cards.name: The Burning Battlefield (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: All your attacking Spirits gain +3000 BP.
When it's the first attack of your turn, the opponents must block with their Spirits if possible.

cards.flavorText:
The first battlefield where the battle between the dragons and dinosaurs occurred. The smell of blood drives even my heart to fight.
-from the Places of Interest 223/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Canyon Where Sage lives (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: You draw +1 card. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
You draw +1 card. Also, if your Life is two or less, you draw +1 card.

cards.flavorText:
The surfaces of the walls are filled with old paintings. The history of this world has been stored in this place by a clan.
-from the Places of Interest 13/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Canyon Where Sage lives (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Ruby Sun (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When the opponent would use a Green/White card, unless they pay one extra cost, it can't be used.
Besides via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when cores are put onto, or removed from an opposing Green/White Spirit, exhaust it.

cards.flavorText:
The 2nd sun summoned by the dragons which refuses the night and forces people to keep being active.
-from the Places of Interest 531/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Ancient Dragon Territory (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, send one core on that Spirit to the Void, instead of the Reserve.
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, you can summon an "Ancient Dragon" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

cards.flavorText:
The place where dragons used to live. The dragons worship this place and the dry winds still carry the traces of those dragons.
-from the Places of Interest 325/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Ancient Dragon Territory (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Lost of Old Castle (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: All your Purple Spirits gain +2000 BP.
If both players have the same number of cards in Hand, or the opponent has more cards than you, you can summon any number of Cost 3 or less Spirit cards from your Trash.

cards.flavorText:
The castle of a ruler before the law of evil world was established. Now it's a forbidden area and no one can enter. If you wish to see the inside, sneak in on your own responsibility.
-from the Places of Interest 411/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Lost of Old Castle (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Swamp of Drain Life (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Send all cores from the opposing Reserve and one core from any opposing Spirit to their Trash.
For each "Ogre Wizard" family Spirit you control, send one core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
The swamp which takes lives of people who come close. They say that it has many bodies of nobles from the evil world in its depths.
-from the Places of Interest 412/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Swamp of Drain Life (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spirit/Ultimate is exhausted, draw a card.
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Nexus to your Trash, destroy an opposing blocking Spirit/Ultimate.

cards.flavorText:
The first and the last revolt against the nobles of the evil world. The outcome may easily be guessed.
-from the Places of Interest 224/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
cards.wikiTitle: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed

galleryImages.caption: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Shackles of Doom (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Spirits/Ultimates with one core on them can't attack/block.
Unless the opponent sends two cores from the Spirit/Ultimate that would attack to the Trash, they can't attack.

cards.flavorText:
The grave of one of the Seven Shoguns who appeared in this world first. Has he been slumbering here waiting for a day of reincarnation.
-from the Places of Interest 444/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Shackles of Doom (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Hermit Wise Tree (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When comparing BP, for each exhausted spirit you control, all your battling Spirits gain +1000 BP.
Refresh all your Spirits. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Nexus, also, put a core from the Void each to all your Spirits that refreshed.

cards.flavorText:
The Hermit Wise Tree which has been there since the initial stage of the woods. It told us a secret of the World Tree. I wonder if it survived the mass destruction by the Duke.
-from the Places of Interest 8/1000 or "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Hermit Wise Tree (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Fruit of Life (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by the opponent, draw a card.
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Reserve, and exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
They say that the fruit of the World Tree gives an eternal youth and immortality to the people who eat it. What do they lose in return?
-from the Places of Interest 118/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Fruit of Life (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Anthill (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh one of your blocking Spirits.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh a Spirit you control, and you can summon a "Parasite" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

cards.flavorText:
The big colony of the Emeants. Seeing Emeants coming in and out from the tower is pretty spectacular.
-from the Places of Interest 801/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Hill of Violent Wind (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Refresh every Spirit with [High Speed]/[Windstorm]/[Bunshin] you control.
When your Spirit is summoned, during this turn it gets +4000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
A small hill which commands a good view of the entire woods which people believe to be the origin of the World Tree. A view of the woods will give you a better understanding of how unique it is.
-from the Places of Interest 802/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Hill of Violent Wind (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Timeless Ice Field (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: All your blocking Spirits gain +3000 BP.
You can target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack at the start of the Attack Step.

cards.flavorText:
The field of ice that never melts and is not cold at all. Ever since the invasion, it became an ice that isn't ice.
-From the Places of Interest 126/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Timeless Ice Field (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Diamond Moon (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: When blocked by opposing Red/Purple Spirits, or when blocking an opposing Spirit, your Spirits get +3000 BP.
Destroy an opposing Red/Purple Spirit that battled with your Spirit at the end of the battle.

cards.flavorText:
The other moon that can partially be seen from the gate of distortion. It gives off cold lights as it takes the lives of all the living things.
-From the Places of Interest 612/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Castle of Eternal Snow (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Return an opposing Nexus to the Hand. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Nexus, instead, return an opposing Nexus to the decktop.
Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
One of the hopes left on that island. it generates the clear singing voice like a glass and hinders any invasions.
-From the Places of Interest 26/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Castle of Eternal Snow (Revival) — Card Art

cards.name: The Invaded Silver Snow (Revival)
cards.setName: Revival Booster: Rebirth of the Dragon Emperor

effects.text: Send all cores from your Trash to your Reserve. When [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is sent to your Reserve by this effect, refresh all your "Machine" family Spirits.

cards.flavorText:

cards.name: Erimakilizard

cards.name: Katanakasago
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

With amazing strength, he endured the flames covering his body. However, another spirit suddenly jumped out and slashed his throat, ending his life abruptly.
-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Ankillersaurus
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: While you control any Spirit with [Awaken]/[Clash], this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The game may be up for the terra dragons; I'm surprised they were defeated so quickly by small fry. The shortness of the battle might also allow them to recover quickly, though.

cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: This Spirit can't be returned to the Hand from your Field by opposing Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: Those in vulnerable positions are always forced to undertake dangerous tasks. It must be a nightmare to bring up the rear of the losing army.

cards.name: The FineDragon Windrake

The rulers of the sky were the first to fight the dragons of the Empty Sky.
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Styrahorn
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText: Apparently they were not only overpowered by the dragons; something seems to have happened to the troops at the rear. Would you like to go and have a look?

cards.name: The ThunderEmperorDragon Siegwurm
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: The opponent must block if possible.
Give every Spirit with [Awaken] you control: [Clash].

cards.flavorText: He paralyzes his opponents with lightning. No one can avoid his attacks.

cards.name: Bone-Dog
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText:
It was a tragic sight. The knights of the Empty Sky generated powerful waves that made everything collapse. The crack in the Empty Sky bought destruction to everyone, including the undead. It was clear that they would not spare even this immortal realm.
-from the 8th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Komoribrella
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText: Although they have been slothful and overconfident, the former rulers have finally come to understand the situation.

cards.name: The HellFighter Balam
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: Destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked at the end of battle.

cards.flavorText: Some warriors have sold their souls to the demons in order to fight against the soldiers of the Empty Sky. Many more are expected to follow them.

cards.name: The DoubleHead Snake
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: Draw a card.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, draw a card.

cards.name: The HellFencer Berith
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

cards.flavorText: The former ruler was transformed by the wisdom of the snake and the strength of the demons. He needed both to fight against the Empty Sky.

cards.name: Skunks
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText: I can see that he's trying hard to drive off the rowdies. He's quite nimble and helpful, but everyone says they don't want to team up with him. If only his weapon was not gas!

cards.name: Hacchidori
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText:
Quite unexpectedly, tiny birds were the first to defeat a knight of the Empty Sky. They tried a strategy that wouldn't be effective against dragons: flying into the enemy's mouth all at once.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The HeavyArmoredBug Caterbarga
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: While your Life is three or less, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.name: Momongul
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText:

-from the 2nd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

cards.name: The Sacred Gungnir

cards.name: Glasscargot
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity
cards.flavorText:
I had to face another tragedy here. The one who tried to circulate a warning by clinging to the dragon's body noticed a greater danger, but he never returned.
-from the 7th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Artifact Droiden
cards.setName: Blazing Thunder & Diamond Deity

effects.text: All your White Spirits gain +1000 BP.

The black orbs... seen... right after the mass destruction... They were the eyes of the TwinDragon... Tearing the world apart, just watching...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.flavorText:
The abnormalities have ceased. But as it is, the same problems will rise again eventually. Worried of this possibility, Guren-san left a method of dealing with it.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.jpName: 流星の剣聖シューティングスター

cards.flavorText:
What Guren-san had prepared, was a 13th Sword. By enshrining it in the country connecting to the two worlds, both of the worlds would be stabilized.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.flavorText: Just because it's peaceful now doesn't mean they've lost their purpose. In preparation for the next disaster, they must not lower their guard.

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.
Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

cards.flavorText: In accordance with its rising status, its armor has become more ornate. Will the next armor it wears be gold?

Treat the "When Braved BP+" of all opposing Brave Spirits as 0.

cards.flavorText: The dragon which appeared from the faraway galaxy made the light converge and guided its shine.

cards.name: Caucasustricera
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When your "Parasite" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When your "Terra Dragon" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The dinosaur running across the earth used a taboo method of absorbing another species to gain the ability to fly.

cards.name: Wingwinder
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step) When you are summoning an "Aldius"-named Spirit card from your Hand, by exhausting this Spirit, reduce the cost by -2.

cards.flavorText:
The snake says that though our future is known, nothing is known about the ones that came from another dimension.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

Your "core removal effects" send +1 core to the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Slay the purple crystal snake and take its amethyst scale. Possessing that scale is a mark of having become a full-fledged swordsman.

galleryImages.caption: Battle Spirits Sword Eyes Gekitouden Wafers

cards.flavorText: The wolf man who instrumented the fall of the midnight sun changed on a moonlit night, awakening his new self with the power of his blackened armor.

cards.flavorText: The Swords Master that serves the White Snake Emperor fought to defend knowledge.

cards.name: Bone-Ceros

cards.flavorText:
The nobles and the bones have both disappeared... they haven't been found... but one day, they will... arise like the phantoms they are...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: Your "core removal effects" send +1 core to the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: The KnightSnake and the white knight dragon. When the two knight dragons align, their individual strengths evolve into something even more powerful.

cards.flavorText: Having made a contract with the Twin Dragon of Darkness, the malevolent SwordMaster who leads the Six Darkness SwordsMasters. Wrapped in dark fog, he harvests lives with the DemonSword Deathscythe.

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. When this effect destroys any Spirit, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Where there is light, shadows are sure to lurk. Even the emperor ruling over the realm of light has a shadow.

cards.flavorText: Once but a shadow of various creatures, under the influence of its regret, it has resurrected as a grotesque creature.

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

[LV2][LV3] When your Bunshin Spirit is put onto the Field, put a core from the Void to that Spirit. This effect can only be used once per turn.

cards.flavorText: Walking on water with special shoes seems very useful. I thought to study under a master so I could learn it, but I gave up upon learning that it requires mind-exhaustive training... Ninjas must be feared.

cards.name: Yoroibatta
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.timing: Flash - High Speed - This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
They don't have a commander... there's been trouble... deciding the successor... Wouldn't that small caterpillar be all right?... Or not?...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.name: Mushatanuki
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.timing: [LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed) Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The culprit is the TwinDragon of Darkness that came from another dimension. The page of the Dark Green commander who we saved from death told the shocking truth. They caused the great collapse and sought to exterminate us.
-The Murmurs of Blacksmith Guren-

cards.name: The FireShinobi Hashibiro
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

When your "Exalted Sword" family Brave is summoned, activate the [Bunshin] of one of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: The sea of flames it shoots closes off any escape route and devours all.

cards.flavorText: Even for the one who will become Empress, the first step is taken as an earth-crawling caterpillar.

Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The knight of the empress fought to the end with the last swords. That is what makes a real knight.

cards.name: The ShinobiBird Juichi
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: By placing one cards from your decktop onto the Field facedown and putting at least one core from the Reserve onto it, until the end of the game, it is treated as "Cost 0/"Bunshin" family/LV1: 1 core, 3000 BP/[Green]" Green Bunshin Spirits. (Bunshin Spirits can't be braved, and are discarded when sent to the Hand/Deck.)

cards.flavorText:
The two opposing forces of shinobi were able to reconcile at the end of the long battle. The sword was dedicated, and each side swore that touching the sword was to be forbidden.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.name: The SwordMasterMagusShinobi Jiraiya
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
Activate one of your Spirits' [Bunshin].
For each Bunshin Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The toad he calls upon is multifarious. Working together with the toad, he can make an infinite number of sword techniques.

cards.flavorText: The great sword of Dark Green broke in a fight with the enemy from another dimension.

cards.name: Anagpanzer
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: Rush Purple/Green (While you have Purple/Green symbols, the following effect activate next) [Purple]: Draw a card from your deck. [Green]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

It's carrying materials for the reconstruction... Everyone's desperate... I'll work hard too... for once...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.name: The ImperialMachine Ranger No. 6
cards.jpName: 近衛機レインジャー6号
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

The city of machines continues to show motivated action. Their next destination is apparently the world on the other side of the sky.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.name: The GunStrikeWarrior Maclir
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: By exhausting this Spirit, return an opposing attacking non-braved Spirit to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: The decisive battle between ShineDeity of Light and the TwinDragon of Darkness begins. The Light Sword Master led by the saviour confront the Six Darkness Sword Master. The Sacred Sword War caused by the great collapse now reaches its final turn.

cards.flavorText: The blade of light falling from the sky erases thousands of enemies.

cards.flavorText: The fighting style of the strong-bodied SwordsSaint allows flesh and bone to be cut while still keeping it intact.

effects.text: When you're summoning a "Behemoth"-named Spirit card, by exhausting this Spirit, reduce its cost by 2.
This Spirit is also treated as a Green Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The collapse and conflict have both stopped, and peace has come. The dance of blessing filled with prayers of hope for the future has begun.

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

cards.flavorText: With her companion Pentan, she takes out her staff and recites an incantation. Through the coordinated effort of a person and a penguin, the door to the ruins opened.

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

cards.flavorText: With a "Leave this to me!" sort of energy, the Pentan baffled us with his sudden appearance. Hm? Somebody's coming this way looking like they're in a rush...

cards.name: The PuppeteerAngelia Mariel
cards.jpName: 人形遣いの天使マリエル
cards.setName: Sword Destiny
cards.flavorText: Puppeteers can control objects of larger sizes in proportion to their proficiency. This girl's ArcAngelia master can apparently even control enormous machinery.

cards.name: The Angelia of Light Dariel
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] Charge - Your “BP- effect” decreases 1000 further.
[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When an opposing Spirit has its BP brought down to 0 for the first time this turn, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Now that I've completed my mission, I'm working as a maid in a castle in Angelia country. My job is solely to be that girl's conversational partner.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Light Dariel — Card Art

cards.name: Caprinmel
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) Destroy an opposing LV1 Spirit that blocked your Cost 2 Spirit when the battle resolves at the end of battle.
[LV2][LV3] When your Cost 2 Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, draw a card from your deck.

cards.flavorText:
When I grasped the Divine Sword, Lapis and Rutile added on their own hands as support. The power of the three of us poured in. Little by little, the sword began to glow. And what a glaring brilliance it became---!
-The Murmurs of Blacksmith Guren-

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

All your Braves in Spirit condition can't be blocked by opposing LV1/LV3 Spirits.

cards.flavorText: "By 'manipulated', what do you mean... To atone for this, I shall certainly... u-um, I'll do anything~"

cards.jpName: 氷火の剣聖スフィエル

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step) When your Spirit-condition "Exalted Sword" family Brave attacks, it can activate all its (When Brave Attacks) effects.

cards.flavorText: Swords of fire and ice. She is the only one of the sword users who can wield the two opposite blades at once.

cards.name: The WaterDragonDeity Galgios
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Imaginary Beast"/"Terra Dragon" family Spirits, put a core from the Void to your Life.
All your "Imaginary Beast"/"Terra Dragon" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
The beasts who lost their homes... were taken in by the Angelias... For salvation?... As new messengers?...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: When you're summoning [The SeaEmperorGiant Duranzam] from your Hand, its cost gets -1.

cards.flavorText: The brawny soldier of the undersea empire worked together with the Giant to wrap up the situation. As a result of their remarkable effort, the Empire was restored faster than any other place.

cards.name: Migo
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

When summoning a Cost 8 or more "Fusion Beast" family Spirit card from your Hand, by destroying this Spirit, treat that Spirit card as having all its reduction filled.

cards.flavorText:
We can finally see some ocean... They're rejoicing too... Though you can't tell by their faces... they're probably rejoicing...
-The Murmurs of Rutile, Future Days-

cards.name: Falcopanther

cards.flavorText:
A seven-colored shine covered the sky, the whole world. The black fog, the TwinDragon, everything. --- An aurora sparkled in the heavens. It was like a blessing guiding us to a new world.
-The Murmurs of Blacksmith Guren-

cards.name: The BoarMan Boarboar
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: This Spirit is treated as being one Level higher. Rush Green (While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next) [Green]: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The old structures had to be wrecked first so they could rebuild. I understand their reasoning, but it surprises me how overboard they're going.
-The Murmurs of Lapis, Future Days-

cards.name: The AbyssalSwordMaster Shub-Niggura

cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, you can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.
When your "Fencer"/"Fusion Beast" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: A single SwordMaster holding a long sword stands in our way. "Brainwashed? I follow my liege from the bottom of my heart."

cards.name: The Blacksmith Beta
cards.setName: Sword Destiny

effects.text: [LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step) When you summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave by paying its cost, you can deploy a Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost. This effect can only be used once per turn.

cards.flavorText: The person who understands this journey the best, yet is the least agreeable. As we are both in the same line of business, she has her own claims that she will not concede.

cards.name: The SwordMasterGeneral Firanda
cards.jpName: 剣聖将軍フィランダー
cards.setName: Sword Destiny
